pound.descES: Golpea con las patas o la cola.
pound.descEN: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

karate-chop.descES: Da un golpe cortante. Suele ser crítico.
karate-chop.descEN: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
karate-chop.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

double-slap.descES: Abofetea de dos a cinco veces seguidas.
double-slap.descEN: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
double-slap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

comet-punch.descES: Pega de dos a cinco veces seguidas.
comet-punch.descEN: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
comet-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

mega-punch.descEN: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

pay-day.descES: Arroja monedas al objetivo y las recupera al final del combate.
pay-day.descEN: Coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
pay-day.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. After the battle ends, the winner receives five times the user’s level in extra money for each time this move was used.

fire-punch.descES: Puñetazo ardiente que puede causar quemaduras.
fire-punch.descEN: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.
fire-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

ice-punch.descES: Puñetazo helado que puede llegar a congelar.
ice-punch.descEN: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.
ice-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

thunder-punch.descES: Puñetazo eléctrico que puede paralizar al adversario.
thunder-punch.descEN: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
thunder-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

scratch.descEN: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

vice-grip.descEN: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

guillotine.descES: Ataque cortante que debilita al oponente de un golpe si acierta.
guillotine.descEN: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
guillotine.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

razor-wind.descES: Primero se prepara y en el segundo turno ataca al oponente con ráfagas de viento cortante. Alta probabilidad de ser crítico.
razor-wind.descEN: In this two-turn attack, blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
razor-wind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. User charges for one turn before attacking. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

swords-dance.descES: Baile frenético que aumenta mucho el Ataque.
swords-dance.descEN: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
swords-dance.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

cut.descES: Corta al adversario con garras, guadañas, etc.
cut.descEN: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.

gust.descES: Crea un tornado con las alas y lo lanza contra el objetivo.
gust.descEN: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
gust.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

wing-attack.descES: Golpea al objetivo con unas grandes alas.
wing-attack.descEN: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

whirlwind.descES: Se lleva al objetivo, que es cambiado por otro Pokémon. Si es un Pokémon salvaje, acaba el combate.
whirlwind.descEN: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
whirlwind.efectoMovEN: Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately. Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

fly.descES: El usuario vuela en el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
fly.descEN: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
fly.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User flies high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

bind.descES: Ata y oprime de cuatro a cinco turnos.
bind.descEN: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
bind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

slam.descES: Golpea con la cola o con lianas, por ejemplo, para causar daño al objetivo.
slam.descEN: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

vine-whip.descES: Azota al objetivo con ramas finas.
vine-whip.descEN: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

stomp.descES: Tremendo pisotón que puede hacer que el objetivo se amedrente.
stomp.descEN: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.
stomp.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

double-kick.descES: Una patada doble. Golpea dos veces.
double-kick.descEN: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.
double-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

mega-kick.descEN: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

jump-kick.descES: Da un salto y pega una patada. Si falla, se lesiona.
jump-kick.descEN: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
jump-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

rolling-kick.descES: Da una patada rápida y circular. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.
rolling-kick.descEN: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. This may also make the target flinch.
rolling-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

sand-attack.descES: Arroja arena a la cara y baja la Precisión.
sand-attack.descEN: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.
sand-attack.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

headbutt.descES: Potente cabezazo que puede amedrentar al objetivo.
headbutt.descEN: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.
headbutt.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

horn-attack.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una cornada.
horn-attack.descEN: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

fury-attack.descES: Cornea al objetivo de dos a cinco veces.
fury-attack.descEN: The user attacks by jabbing the target with a horn, a beak, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.
fury-attack.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

horn-drill.descES: Ataque con un cuerno giratorio que fulmina de un solo golpe al objetivo si lo alcanza.
horn-drill.descEN: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
horn-drill.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

tackle.descEN: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

body-slam.descES: Salta sobre el objetivo con todo su peso y puede llegar a paralizarlo.
body-slam.descEN: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
body-slam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

wrap.descES: Oprime al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos con ramas o con su cuerpo.
wrap.descEN: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
wrap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

take-down.descES: Carga desmedida que también hiere al agresor.
take-down.descEN: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.
take-down.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

thrash.descES: Ataque de dos a tres turnos que acaba confundiendo al agresor.
thrash.descEN: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
thrash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

double-edge.descES: Ataque arriesgado que también hiere al agresor.
double-edge.descEN: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
double-edge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

tail-whip.descES: Agita la cola para bajar la Defensa del equipo rival.
tail-whip.descEN: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.
tail-whip.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

poison-sting.descES: Lanza un aguijón tóxico que puede envenenar al objetivo.
poison-sting.descEN: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
poison-sting.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

twineedle.descES: Pincha dos veces con dos espinas. Puede envenenar.
twineedle.descEN: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.
twineedle.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.

pin-missile.descES: Lanza finas púas que hieren de dos a cinco veces.
pin-missile.descEN: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
pin-missile.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

leer.descES: Intimida a los rivales para bajar su Defensa.
leer.descEN: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.
leer.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

bite.descES: Un voraz bocado que puede amedrentar al objetivo.
bite.descEN: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
bite.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

growl.descES: Dulce gruñido que reduce el Ataque del equipo rival.
growl.descEN: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
growl.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

roar.descES: Se lleva al objetivo, que es cambiado por otro Pokémon. Si es un Pokémon salvaje, acaba el combate.
roar.descEN: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
roar.efectoMovEN: Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately. Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

sing.descES: Cancioncilla que hace dormir profundamente al objetivo.
sing.descEN: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

supersonic.descES: Raras ondas sónicas que confunden al objetivo.
supersonic.descEN: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

sonic-boom.descES: Lanza ondas de choque que restan 20 PS al objetivo.
sonic-boom.descEN: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

disable.descES: Desactiva el último movimiento del objetivo durante cuatro turnos.
disable.descEN: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
disable.efectoMovEN: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.

acid.descES: Rocía a los enemigos con un ácido corrosivo. Puede bajar la Defensa Especial.
acid.descEN: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.
acid.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

ember.descES: Ataca con llamas pequeñas que pueden causar quemaduras.
ember.descEN: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
ember.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

flamethrower.descES: Ataca con una gran ráfaga de fuego que puede causar quemaduras.
flamethrower.descEN: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flamethrower.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

mist.descES: Rodea de fina niebla al usuario y protege las características de su equipo durante cinco turnos.
mist.descEN: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.
mist.efectoMovEN: Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns. Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

water-gun.descES: Ataca disparando agua con gran potencia.
water-gun.descEN: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

hydro-pump.descES: Lanza una gran masa de agua a presión para atacar.
hydro-pump.descEN: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

surf.descES: Inunda el terreno de combate con una ola gigante.
surf.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
surf.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

ice-beam.descES: Rayo de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.
ice-beam.descEN: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
ice-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

blizzard.descES: Tormenta de hielo que puede llegar a congelar.
blizzard.descEN: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
blizzard.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

psybeam.descES: Extraño rayo que puede causar confusión.
psybeam.descEN: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.
psybeam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

bubble-beam.descES: Diluvio de burbujas que puede bajar la Velocidad.
bubble-beam.descEN: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
bubble-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

aurora-beam.descES: Rayo multicolor que puede reducir el Ataque.
aurora-beam.descEN: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
aurora-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

hyper-beam.descES: Es eficaz, pero el atacante deberá descansar en el siguiente turno.
hyper-beam.descEN: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
hyper-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

peck.descES: Ensarta al objetivo con un cuerno o pico punzante.
peck.descEN: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

drill-peck.descES: Picotazo giratorio y perforador muy potente.
drill-peck.descEN: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

submission.descES: El usuario se lanza al suelo con el oponente en brazos y también se hace un poco de daño.
submission.descEN: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
submission.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

low-kick.descES: Patada baja que derriba al oponente. Cuanto más pesa el objetivo, más daño le causa.
low-kick.descEN: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
low-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

counter.descES: Devuelve un golpe físico por duplicado.
counter.descEN: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
counter.efectoMovEN: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

seismic-toss.descES: Aprovecha la gravedad para derribar al objetivo. Le resta tantos PS como nivel tenga el usuario.
seismic-toss.descEN: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
seismic-toss.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

strength.descES: Propina un potente puñetazo con todas sus fuerzas.
strength.descEN: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

absorb.descES: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.
absorb.descEN: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
absorb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

mega-drain.descES: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.
mega-drain.descEN: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
mega-drain.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

leech-seed.descES: Planta semillas que absorben PS del objetivo en cada turno y que le sirven para recuperarse.
leech-seed.descEN: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
leech-seed.efectoMovEN: Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field. The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze. Rapid Spin will remove this effect. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

growth.descES: Hace que su cuerpo crezca a marchas forzadas con lo que aumenta su Ataque y Ataque Especial.
growth.descEN: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
growth.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. During Sunny Day, raises both stats by two stages.

razor-leaf.descES: Corta con hojas afiladas. Un ataque que suele ser crítico.
razor-leaf.descEN: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
razor-leaf.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

solar-beam.descES: El usuario absorbe luz en el primer turno y en el segundo lanza un potente rayo de energía.
solar-beam.descEN: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
solar-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

poison-powder.descES: Polvo tóxico que envenena al objetivo.
poison-powder.descEN: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

stun-spore.descES: Esparce polvo que paraliza al objetivo.
stun-spore.descEN: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

sleep-powder.descES: Esparce polvo que duerme al objetivo.
sleep-powder.descEN: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

petal-dance.descES: Lanza pétalos de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al atacante.
petal-dance.descEN: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
petal-dance.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

string-shot.descES: Lanza seda a los rivales y reduce mucho su Velocidad.
string-shot.descEN: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
string-shot.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

dragon-rage.descES: Ráfaga de furiosas ondas de choque que quitan 40 PS.
dragon-rage.descEN: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

fire-spin.descES: Un aro de fuego que atrapa al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos.
fire-spin.descEN: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
fire-spin.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

thunder-shock.descES: Ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.
thunder-shock.descEN: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
thunder-shock.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

thunderbolt.descES: Potente ataque eléctrico que puede paralizar al objetivo.
thunderbolt.descEN: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
thunderbolt.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

thunder-wave.descES: Una ligera descarga que paraliza al objetivo si lo alcanza.
thunder-wave.descEN: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

thunder.descES: Un poderoso rayo que daña al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.
thunder.descEN: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
thunder.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

rock-throw.descES: Tira una pequeña roca al objetivo.
rock-throw.descEN: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

earthquake.descES: Un terremoto que afecta a todos los Pokémon que estén a su alrededor.
earthquake.descEN: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
earthquake.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

fissure.descES: Abre una grieta en el suelo y mete al objetivo en ella. Fulmina en un golpe.
fissure.descEN: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
fissure.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

dig.descES: El usuario cava durante el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
dig.descEN: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
dig.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Earthquake, Fissure, and Magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

toxic.descES: Envenena gravemente al objetivo y causa un daño mayor en cada turno.
toxic.descEN: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
toxic.efectoMovEN: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

confusion.descES: Débil ataque telequinético que puede causar confusión.
confusion.descEN: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
confusion.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

psychic.descES: Fuerte ataque telequinético que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
psychic.descEN: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
psychic.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

hypnosis.descES: Ataque hipnótico que hace dormir profundamente al objetivo.
hypnosis.descEN: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

meditate.descES: El usuario reposa y medita para potenciar el Ataque.
meditate.descEN: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
meditate.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

agility.descES: Relaja el cuerpo para ganar mucha Velocidad.
agility.descEN: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
agility.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

quick-attack.descES: Ataca al objetivo a gran velocidad. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
quick-attack.descEN: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

rage.descES: Al usarse, aumenta el Ataque del usuario cada vez que es golpeado.
rage.descEN: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.
rage.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.

teleport.descES: Permite al usuario cambiarse por otro Pokémon del equipo, si es posible. Si un Pokémon salvaje usa este movimiento, huye del combate.
teleport.descEN: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.
teleport.efectoMovEN: Does nothing. Wild battles end immediately.

night-shade.descES: Produce un espejismo ante el objetivo, que pierde tantos PS como nivel tenga el usuario.
night-shade.descEN: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
night-shade.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

mimic.descES: Copia el último movimiento usado por el objetivo, y puede utilizarlo mientras esté en el combate.
mimic.descEN: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.
mimic.efectoMovEN: This move is replaced by the target’s last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if the user already knows the targeted move, this move will fail. This effect vanishes when the user leaves the field. If Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle is selected, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

screech.descES: Alarido agudo que reduce mucho la Defensa del objetivo.
screech.descEN: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.
screech.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

double-team.descES: Crea copias de sí mismo para mejorar la Evasión.
double-team.descEN: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
double-team.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

recover.descES: Restaura hasta la mitad de los PS máximos.
recover.descEN: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
recover.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP.

harden.descES: Tensa la musculatura del usuario para aumentar la Defensa.
harden.descEN: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.
harden.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

minimize.descES: El usuario mengua para aumentar mucho la Evasión.
minimize.descEN: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.
minimize.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s evasion by two stages. Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field.

smokescreen.descES: Baja la Precisión del objetivo con una nube de humo o tinta.
smokescreen.descEN: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.
smokescreen.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

confuse-ray.descES: Rayo siniestro que confunde al objetivo.
confuse-ray.descEN: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

withdraw.descES: El usuario se resguarda en su coraza, por lo que le sube la Defensa.
withdraw.descEN: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
withdraw.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

defense-curl.descES: Se enrosca para ocultar sus puntos débiles y aumentar la Defensa.
defense-curl.descEN: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.
defense-curl.efectoMovEN: Raises user’s Defense by one stage. After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.

barrier.descES: Crea una barrera que aumenta mucho la Defensa.
barrier.descEN: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
barrier.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

light-screen.descES: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques especiales.
light-screen.descEN: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
light-screen.efectoMovEN: Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

haze.descES: Neblina que elimina los cambios de características de todos los Pokémon en combate.
haze.descEN: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
haze.efectoMovEN: Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field. This does not count as a stat reduction for the purposes of Clear Body or White Smoke.

reflect.descES: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques físicos.
reflect.descEN: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
reflect.efectoMovEN: Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

focus-energy.descES: Concentra energía para aumentar las posibilidades de asestar un golpe crítico.
focus-energy.descEN: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.
focus-energy.efectoMovEN: User’s critical hit rate is two levels higher until it leaves the field. If the user has already used Focus Energy since entering the field, this move will fail. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

bide.descES: Espera dos turnos para atacar con el doble de potencia del daño recibido.
bide.descEN: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
bide.efectoMovEN: User waits for two turns. On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it. Damage inflicted is typeless. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

metronome.descES: Mueve un dedo y estimula su cerebro para usar al azar casi cualquier movimiento.
metronome.descEN: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
metronome.efectoMovEN: Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. Assist, meta, protection, and reflection moves are also not eligible; specifically, Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Quick Guard, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, and Wide Guard will not be selected by this move. This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

mirror-move.descES: Ataca al objetivo con el último movimiento que este haya usado.
mirror-move.descEN: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
mirror-move.efectoMovEN: Uses the last move targeted at the user by a Pokémon still on the field. A move counts as targeting the user even if it hit multiple Pokémon, as long as the user was one of them; however, moves targeting the field itself do not count. If the user has not been targeted by an appropriate move since entering the field, or if no Pokémon that targeted the user remains on the field, this move will fail. Moves that failed, missed, had no effect, or were blocked are still copied. Assist moves, time-delayed moves, “meta” moves that operate on other moves/Pokémon/abilities, and some other special moves cannot be copied and are ignored; if the last move to hit the user was such a move, the previous move will be used instead. The full list of ignored moves is: Acid Armor, Acupressure, After You, Agility, Ally Switch, Amnesia, Aqua Ring, Aromatherapy, Aromatic Mist, Assist, Autotomize, Barrier, Baton Pass, Belch, Belly Drum, Bide, Bulk Up, Calm Mind, Camouflage, Celebrate, Charge, Coil, Conversion, Conversion 2, Copycat, Cosmic Power, Cotton Guard, Counter, Crafty Shield, Curse, Defend Order, Defense Curl, Destiny Bond, Detect, Doom Desire, Double Team, Dragon Dance, Electric Terrain, Endure, Final Gambit, Flower Shield, Focus Energy, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Future Sight, Geomancy, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Growth, Grudge, Guard Split, Hail, Happy Hour, Harden, Haze, Heal Bell, Heal Order, Heal Pulse, Healing Wish, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hone Claws, Howl, Imprison, Ingrain, Ion Deluge, Iron Defense, King’s Shield, Light Screen, Lucky Chant, Lunar Dance, Magic Coat, Magnet Rise, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Me First, Meditate, Metronome, Milk Drink, Mimic, Minimize, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Mist, Misty Terrain, Moonlight, Morning Sun, Mud Sport, Nasty Plot, Nature Power, Perish Song, Power Split, Power Trick, Protect, Psych Up, Quick Guard, Quiver Dance, Rage Powder, Rain Dance, Recover, Recycle, Reflect, Reflect Type, Refresh, Rest, Rock Polish, Role Play, Roost, Rototiller, Safeguard, Sandstorm, Shadow Blast, Shadow Bolt, Shadow Half, Shadow Rush, Shadow Shed, Shadow Sky, Shadow Storm, Shadow Wave, Sharpen, Shell Smash, Shift Gear, Sketch, Slack Off, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Soft-Boiled, Spikes, Spiky Shield, Spit Up, Splash, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Stockpile, Struggle, Substitute, Sunny Day, Swallow, Swords Dance, Synthesis, Tail Glow, Tailwind, Teleport, Toxic Spikes, Transform, Water Sport, Wide Guard, Wish, Withdraw and Work Up. This move cannot be selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk, nor forced by Encore.

self-destruct.descES: El atacante explota y hiere a todos a su alrededor. El usuario se debilita de inmediato.
self-destruct.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
self-destruct.efectoMovEN: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

egg-bomb.descES: Arroja un huevo enorme al objetivo con gran fuerza.
egg-bomb.descEN: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

lick.descES: Una lengua ataca al objetivo. Puede causar parálisis.
lick.descEN: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
lick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

smog.descES: Lanza un ataque con gases tóxicos que pueden llegar a envenenar.
smog.descEN: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
smog.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

sludge.descES: Arroja residuos al objetivo. Puede llegar a envenenar.
sludge.descEN: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
sludge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

bone-club.descES: Aporrea con un hueso. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.
bone-club.descEN: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.
bone-club.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

fire-blast.descES: Llama intensa que chamusca y puede causar quemaduras.
fire-blast.descEN: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
fire-blast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

waterfall.descES: Embiste con un gran impulso que puede llegar a amedrentar.
waterfall.descEN: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
waterfall.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

clamp.descES: Atrapa y atenaza con fuerza durante cuatro o cinco turnos.
clamp.descEN: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
clamp.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

swift.descES: Lanza rayos en forma de estrella que no fallan nunca.
swift.descEN: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
swift.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

skull-bash.descES: El usuario se prepara y sube su Defensa en el primer turno y en el segundo arremete con un cabezazo.
skull-bash.descEN: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
skull-bash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. User then charges for one turn before attacking. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

spike-cannon.descES: Lanza finas púas que hieren de dos a cinco veces.
spike-cannon.descEN: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
spike-cannon.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

constrict.descES: Ataca con largos tentáculos o zarcillos que pueden bajar la Velocidad.
constrict.descEN: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
constrict.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

amnesia.descES: El usuario olvida sus preocupaciones y aumenta mucho la Defensa Especial.
amnesia.descEN: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
amnesia.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

kinesis.descES: Dobla una cuchara para distraer al objetivo y bajar su nivel de Precisión.
kinesis.descEN: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
kinesis.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

soft-boiled.descES: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario.
soft-boiled.descEN: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
soft-boiled.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP.

high-jump-kick.descES: El usuario salta muy alto y da un rodillazo. Si falla, se hará daño.
high-jump-kick.descEN: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
high-jump-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

glare.descES: Intimida y asusta al objetivo con la mirada para dejarlo paralizado.
glare.descEN: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

dream-eater.descES: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado a un objetivo dormido.
dream-eater.descEN: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
dream-eater.efectoMovEN: Fails if not used on a sleeping Pokémon. Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

poison-gas.descES: Lanza una nube de gas tóxico al objetivo. Produce envenenamiento.
poison-gas.descEN: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

barrage.descES: Arroja esferas al objetivo entre dos y cinco veces seguidas.
barrage.descEN: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
barrage.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

leech-life.descES: Restaura al usuario la mitad del daño causado al objetivo.
leech-life.descEN: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
leech-life.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

lovely-kiss.descES: Intimida al objetivo con una cara que asusta y le da un beso que lo deja dormido.
lovely-kiss.descEN: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

sky-attack.descES: Ataca durante dos turnos y suele asestar un golpe crítico. También puede amedrentar al objetivo.
sky-attack.descEN: The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.
sky-attack.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. Critical hit chance is one level higher than normal. Has a chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

transform.descES: El usuario se transforma en una copia del objetivo, con los mismos movimientos.
transform.descEN: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.
transform.efectoMovEN: User copies the target’s species, weight, type, ability, calculated stats (except HP), and moves. Copied moves will all have 5 PP remaining. IVs are copied for the purposes of Hidden Power, but stats are not recalculated. Choice Band, Choice Scarf, and Choice Specs stay in effect, and the user must select a new move. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor forced by Encore.

bubble.descES: Lanza burbujas a los contrincantes y puede reducir su Velocidad.
bubble.descEN: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.
bubble.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

dizzy-punch.descES: Rítmicos puñetazos que pueden causar confusión.
dizzy-punch.descEN: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.
dizzy-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

spore.descES: Esparce esporas que inducen al sueño.
spore.descEN: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

flash.descES: Luz cegadora que baja la Precisión del objetivo.
flash.descEN: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy.
flash.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

psywave.descES: Ataque con una onda de energía de intensidad variable.
psywave.descEN: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
psywave.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level, selected at random in increments of 10%.

splash.descES: No tiene ningún efecto. Solo salpica.
splash.descEN: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
splash.efectoMovEN: Does nothing. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

acid-armor.descES: Transforma la estructura celular para hacerse líquido y aumenta mucho la Defensa.
acid-armor.descEN: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
acid-armor.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

crabhammer.descES: Golpea con fuerza con una pinza enorme. Suele asestar un golpe crítico.
crabhammer.descEN: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
crabhammer.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

explosion.descES: El atacante causa una grandísima explosión y hiere a todos a su alrededor. El usuario se debilita de inmediato.
explosion.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
explosion.efectoMovEN: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

fury-swipes.descES: Araña rápidamente de dos a cinco veces.
fury-swipes.descEN: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.
fury-swipes.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

bonemerang.descES: Lanza un hueso a modo de bumerán que golpea dos veces.
bonemerang.descEN: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.
bonemerang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

rest.descES: Restaura todos los PS y cura todos los problemas de estado del usuario, que se duerme los dos turnos siguientes.
rest.descEN: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.
rest.efectoMovEN: User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird. This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

rock-slide.descES: Lanza grandes pedruscos. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
rock-slide.descEN: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
rock-slide.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

hyper-fang.descES: Ataca con agudos colmillos. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
hyper-fang.descEN: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
hyper-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

sharpen.descES: El perfil del usuario se hace más afilado y su Ataque mejora.
sharpen.descEN: The user makes its edges more jagged, which raises its Attack stat.
sharpen.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

conversion.descES: Cambia el tipo del usuario por el del primero de sus movimientos.
conversion.descEN: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.
conversion.efectoMovEN: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves, selected at random. Hidden Power and Weather Ball are treated as Normal. Only moves with a different type are eligible, and Curse is never eligible. If the user has no suitable moves, this move will fail.

tri-attack.descES: Ataque triple que puede paralizar, quemar o congelar al objetivo.
tri-attack.descEN: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
tri-attack.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target. One of these effects is selected at random; they do not each have independent chances to occur.

super-fang.descES: Finos colmillos que reducen a la mitad los PS del objetivo.
super-fang.descEN: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.
super-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

slash.descES: Ataca con cuchillas o con pinzas. Suele asestar un golpe crítico.
slash.descEN: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
slash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

substitute.descES: Utiliza parte de los PS propios para crear un sustituto que actúa como señuelo.
substitute.descEN: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
substitute.efectoMovEN: Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

struggle.descES: Solo se usa como último recurso al acabarse los PP. Hiere un poco al agresor.
struggle.descEN: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.
struggle.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless regular damage. User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both Encore and Torment at the same time. This move’s recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability Rock Head. It also is not prevented by Magic Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

sketch.descES: Aprende de forma permanente el último movimiento utilizado por el objetivo. Es de un solo uso.
sketch.descEN: This move enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
sketch.efectoMovEN: Permanently replaces itself with the target’s last used move. If that move is Chatter or Struggle, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

triple-kick.descES: Patea hasta tres veces seguidas y cada vez más fuerte.
triple-kick.descEN: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
triple-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply.

thief.descES: El agresor ataca y le quita el objeto al objetivo siempre y cuando no lleve ninguno.
thief.descEN: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
thief.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

spider-web.descES: Enreda al objetivo para evitar que abandone el combate.
spider-web.descEN: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
spider-web.efectoMovEN: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

mind-reader.descES: El usuario adivina los movimientos del objetivo para hacer que su siguiente ataque no falle.
mind-reader.descEN: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
mind-reader.efectoMovEN: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

nightmare.descES: El objetivo dormido sufre una pesadilla que le hace perder PS en cada turno.
nightmare.descEN: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
nightmare.efectoMovEN: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Gives the target a nightmare, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. If the target wakes up or leaves the field, this effect ends.

flame-wheel.descES: Ataca envuelto en fuego. Puede causar quemaduras.
flame-wheel.descEN: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flame-wheel.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

snore.descES: Fuerte ronquido que solo puede usarse dormido. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
snore.descEN: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
snore.efectoMovEN: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

curse.descES: Un movimiento que tiene efectos distintos si el usuario es de tipo Fantasma o no.
curse.descEN: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
curse.efectoMovEN: If the user is a Ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. Otherwise: Lowers the user’s Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each. The curse effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flail.descES: Ataque frenético. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, más daño producirá.
flail.descEN: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.
flail.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

conversion-2.descES: El usuario cambia de tipo para hacerse resistente al último tipo de movimiento usado por el objetivo.
conversion-2.descEN: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.
conversion-2.efectoMovEN: Changes the user’s type to a type either resistant or immune to the last damaging move that hit it. The new type is selected at random and cannot be a type the user already is. If there is no eligible new type, this move will fail.

aeroblast.descES: Lanza un chorro de aire que suele asestar un golpe crítico.
aeroblast.descEN: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
aeroblast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

cotton-spore.descES: Adhiere esporas a los rivales para reducir mucho su Velocidad.
cotton-spore.descEN: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.
cotton-spore.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

reversal.descES: Ataque desesperado que causa más daño cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario.
reversal.descEN: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
reversal.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

spite.descES: Da rienda suelta a su rencor para reducir cuatro PP del último movimiento usado por el objetivo.
spite.descEN: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
spite.efectoMovEN: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

powder-snow.descES: Lanza nieve que puede llegar a congelar.
powder-snow.descEN: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.
powder-snow.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

protect.descES: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
protect.descEN: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
protect.efectoMovEN: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

mach-punch.descES: Puñetazo de velocidad fulminante. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
mach-punch.descEN: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

scary-face.descES: Asusta al objetivo para reducir mucho su Velocidad.
scary-face.descEN: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.
scary-face.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

feint-attack.descES: Engaña al objetivo para acercarse y dar un puñetazo que no falla.
feint-attack.descEN: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.
feint-attack.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

sweet-kiss.descES: Da un beso con tal dulzura que causa confusión.
sweet-kiss.descEN: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

belly-drum.descES: Reduce la mitad de los PS máximos para mejorar al máximo el Ataque.
belly-drum.descEN: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
belly-drum.efectoMovEN: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

sludge-bomb.descES: Arroja residuos al objetivo. Puede llegar a envenenar.
sludge-bomb.descEN: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
sludge-bomb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

mud-slap.descES: Echa lodo en la cara para bajar la Precisión.
mud-slap.descEN: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
mud-slap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

octazooka.descES: Dispara tinta a la cara. Puede bajar la Precisión.
octazooka.descEN: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
octazooka.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

spikes.descES: Esparce púas alrededor del equipo rival que hieren a los Pokémon rivales que entran en combate.
spikes.descEN: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
spikes.efectoMovEN: Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP. Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.

zap-cannon.descES: Dispara una descarga eléctrica que causa daño y parálisis.
zap-cannon.descEN: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
zap-cannon.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

foresight.descES: Permite atacar con cualquier movimiento a objetivos de tipo Fantasma y golpear a Pokémon evasivos.
foresight.descEN: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
foresight.efectoMovEN: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

destiny-bond.descES: Si el usuario se debilita por un ataque rival antes de usar otro movimiento, el Pokémon rival se debilitará también. Puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
destiny-bond.descEN: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
destiny-bond.efectoMovEN: If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

perish-song.descES: Si un Pokémon escucha este canto y no es cambiado por otro en tres turnos, acaba debilitándose.
perish-song.descEN: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
perish-song.efectoMovEN: Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

icy-wind.descES: Ataque con aire helado que baja la Velocidad de los rivales.
icy-wind.descEN: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.
icy-wind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

detect.descES: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
detect.descEN: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
detect.efectoMovEN: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

bone-rush.descES: Hueso en ristre, aporrea al objetivo de dos a cinco veces.
bone-rush.descEN: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
bone-rush.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

lock-on.descES: Fija el blanco para que el siguiente ataque no falle.
lock-on.descEN: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.
lock-on.efectoMovEN: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

outrage.descES: Ataca de dos a tres turnos y acaba confundiendo al agresor.
outrage.descEN: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
outrage.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

sandstorm.descES: Tormenta de arena que dura cinco turnos y hiere a todos, excepto a los de tipo Roca, Tierra y Acero, y aumenta la Defensa Especial de los de tipo Roca.
sandstorm.descEN: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.
sandstorm.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

giga-drain.descES: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.
giga-drain.descEN: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
giga-drain.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

endure.descES: Resiste cualquier ataque y deja al menos 1 PS. Puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
endure.descEN: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
endure.efectoMovEN: The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

charm.descES: Engatusa al objetivo y reduce mucho su Ataque.
charm.descEN: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
charm.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

rollout.descES: El atacante rueda contra el objetivo durante cinco turnos, cada vez con mayor fuerza.
rollout.descEN: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.
rollout.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

false-swipe.descES: Ataque moderado que no debilita al objetivo y le deja al menos 1 PS.
false-swipe.descEN: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
false-swipe.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

swagger.descES: Provoca confusión en el objetivo, pero también sube mucho su Ataque.
swagger.descEN: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
swagger.efectoMovEN: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

milk-drink.descES: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario.
milk-drink.descEN: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
milk-drink.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP.

spark.descES: Ataque eléctrico que puede llegar a paralizar.
spark.descEN: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
spark.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

fury-cutter.descES: Ataque con garras o guadaña que crece en intensidad si se usa repetidas veces.
fury-cutter.descEN: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
fury-cutter.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

steel-wing.descES: Alas macizas que golpean al objetivo y pueden subir la Defensa del usuario.
steel-wing.descEN: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.
steel-wing.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.

mean-look.descES: Mal de ojo que impide al objetivo huir del combate.
mean-look.descEN: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
mean-look.efectoMovEN: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

attract.descES: Si el objetivo es del sexo opuesto, se enamorará y bajará la posibilidad de que ataque.
attract.descEN: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
