attract.efectoMovEN: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.

sleep-talk.descES: Mientras duerme, usa uno de sus movimientos elegido al azar.
sleep-talk.descEN: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.
sleep-talk.efectoMovEN: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP. This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar. If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

heal-bell.descES: Tañido que cura los problemas de estado de todos los Pokémon del equipo.
heal-bell.descEN: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
heal-bell.efectoMovEN: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

return.descES: Cuanto mayor sea la amistad con el Entrenador, más poderoso será este ataque.
return.descEN: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
return.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

present.descES: Quien lo usa ataca al objetivo dándole un regalo con una bomba trampa. Sin embargo, a veces restaura sus PS.
present.descEN: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
present.efectoMovEN: Randomly uses one of the following effects. Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20% On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

frustration.descES: Cuanto menor sea la amistad con el Entrenador, más poderoso será este ataque.
frustration.descEN: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
frustration.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

safeguard.descES: Un escudo que protege de problemas de estado, como el sueño o la parálisis, durante cinco turnos.
safeguard.descEN: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
safeguard.efectoMovEN: Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field. If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect. This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.

pain-split.descES: Suma los PS del usuario a los del objetivo y los reparte a partes iguales.
pain-split.descEN: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.
pain-split.efectoMovEN: Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken. This effect fails against a Substitute.

sacred-fire.descES: Fuego místico de gran intensidad que puede causar quemaduras.
sacred-fire.descEN: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.
sacred-fire.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

magnitude.descES: Sacudida sísmica de intensidad variable que afecta a todos los Pokémon a su alrededor.
magnitude.descEN: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.
magnitude.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71: Magnitude | Power | Chance --------: | ----: | -----: 4 | 10 | 5% 5 | 30 | 10% 6 | 50 | 20% 7 | 70 | 30% 8 | 90 | 20% 9 | 110 | 10% 10 | 150 | 5% This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.

dynamic-punch.descES: Puñetazo con toda la fuerza concentrada. Causa confusión si atina.
dynamic-punch.descEN: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
dynamic-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

megahorn.descEN: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

dragon-breath.descES: Poderosa ráfaga de aliento que golpea al objetivo y puede paralizarlo.
dragon-breath.descEN: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
dragon-breath.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

baton-pass.descES: Cambia el puesto con otro miembro del equipo y le pasa los cambios de características.
baton-pass.descEN: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
baton-pass.efectoMovEN: User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon. The following move effects are passed: * Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

encore.descES: El objetivo repite su último movimiento durante tres turnos.
encore.descEN: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
encore.efectoMovEN: The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.

pursuit.descES: Hace el doble de daño al objetivo que pide el relevo.
pursuit.descEN: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.
pursuit.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power. This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.

rapid-spin.descES: Ataque giratorio que puede eliminar movimientos como Atadura, Constricción y Drenadoras. También aumenta la Velocidad del usuario.
rapid-spin.descEN: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
rapid-spin.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.

sweet-scent.descES: Un dulce aroma engatusa al objetivo, por lo que se reduce mucho su Evasión.
sweet-scent.descEN: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
sweet-scent.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

iron-tail.descES: Ataca con una cola férrea y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.
iron-tail.descEN: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
iron-tail.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

metal-claw.descES: Ataque con garras de acero que puede aumentar el Ataque del usuario.
metal-claw.descEN: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.
metal-claw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

vital-throw.descES: El usuario ataca el último, pero no falla.
vital-throw.descEN: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
vital-throw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

morning-sun.descES: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.
morning-sun.descEN: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
morning-sun.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

synthesis.descES: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.
synthesis.descEN: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
synthesis.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moonlight.descES: Restaura PS del usuario. La cantidad varía según el tiempo que haga.
moonlight.descEN: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moonlight.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

hidden-power.descES: Movimiento cuyo tipo varía en función del Pokémon que lo usa.
hidden-power.descEN: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.
hidden-power.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

cross-chop.descES: Corte doble que suele propinar un golpe crítico.
cross-chop.descEN: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cross-chop.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

twister.descES: Crea un violento tornado para hacer trizas al objetivo. Puede amedrentarlo.
twister.descEN: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
twister.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make each target flinch. If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

rain-dance.descES: Genera una fuerte lluvia que refuerza los movimientos de tipo Agua durante cinco turnos y debilita los de tipo Fuego.
rain-dance.descEN: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.
rain-dance.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

sunny-day.descES: Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos, lo que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego y debilita los de tipo Agua.
sunny-day.descEN: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
sunny-day.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

crunch.descES: Tritura con afilados colmillos y puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.
crunch.descEN: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
crunch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

mirror-coat.descES: Responde a un ataque especial ocasionando el doble del daño recibido.
mirror-coat.descEN: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
mirror-coat.efectoMovEN: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

psych-up.descES: Quien lo usa se sume en un trance y copia cualquier cambio que haya en las características de su objetivo.
psych-up.descEN: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
psych-up.efectoMovEN: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

extreme-speed.descES: Ataque de una velocidad extrema. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
extreme-speed.descEN: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

ancient-power.descES: Ataque prehistórico que puede subir todas las características.
ancient-power.descEN: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
ancient-power.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

shadow-ball.descES: Lanza una bola oscura que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
shadow-ball.descEN: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
shadow-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

future-sight.descES: Concentra energía psíquica para golpear al objetivo dos turnos después.
future-sight.descEN: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
future-sight.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

rock-smash.descES: Ataque con los puños. Puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo.
rock-smash.descEN: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
rock-smash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

whirlpool.descES: Una tromba de agua atrapa al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos.
whirlpool.descEN: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
whirlpool.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

beat-up.descES: Ataque de todo el equipo Pokémon. Cuantos más haya, más veces se atacará.
beat-up.descEN: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
beat-up.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

fake-out.descES: Amedrenta al objetivo con este movimiento de prioridad alta. Solo sirve en el primer turno.
fake-out.descEN: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
fake-out.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

uproar.descES: Ataca de forma alborotada durante tres turnos. Mantiene despiertos a todos.
uproar.descEN: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
uproar.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends. Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

stockpile.descES: Acumula energía y sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial. Puede utilizarse hasta tres veces.
stockpile.descEN: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.
stockpile.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied. If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

spit-up.descES: Libera de una vez la energía acumulada con Reserva. La potencia del ataque será proporcional a la cantidad de energía acumulada.
spit-up.descEN: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.
spit-up.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile. Ignores the random factor in the damage formula. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

swallow.descES: Absorbe la energía acumulada con Reserva para recobrar salud. Cuanta más se haya acumulado, mayor será el número de PS que se recuperen.
swallow.descEN: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
swallow.efectoMovEN: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

heat-wave.descES: Provoca un viento abrasador que puede quemar al objetivo.
heat-wave.descEN: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.
heat-wave.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

hail.descES: Tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos. Hiere a todos los Pokémon excepto a los de tipo Hielo.
hail.descEN: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
hail.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

torment.descES: Atormenta y enfurece al objetivo, que no puede usar dos veces seguidas el mismo movimiento.
torment.descEN: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
torment.efectoMovEN: Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row. When the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead. The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.

flatter.descES: Halaga al objetivo y lo confunde, pero también sube su Ataque Especial.
flatter.descEN: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.
flatter.efectoMovEN: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

will-o-wisp.descES: Siniestra llama morada que produce quemaduras.
will-o-wisp.descEN: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

memento.descES: El usuario se debilita, pero baja mucho tanto el Ataque como el Ataque Especial del objetivo.
memento.descEN: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
memento.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

facade.descES: Si el usuario está quemado, paralizado o envenenado, ataca con el doble de potencia.
facade.descEN: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
facade.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

focus-punch.descES: Se concentra para dar un puñetazo. Falla si se sufre un golpe antes de su uso.
focus-punch.descEN: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.
focus-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

smelling-salts.descES: Hace el doble de daño a objetivos paralizados, pero también cura la parálisis.
smelling-salts.descEN: This attack’s power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.
smelling-salts.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

follow-me.descES: Llama la atención para concentrar todos los ataques de todos los del equipo rival hacia sí mismo.
follow-me.descEN: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
follow-me.efectoMovEN: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

nature-power.descES: Usa el poder de la naturaleza para atacar. Su efecto varía según el entorno de combate.
nature-power.descEN: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
nature-power.efectoMovEN: Uses another move chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Selected move ------------------------- | ------------------ Building | Tri Attack Cave | Rock Slide Deep water | Hydro Pump Desert | Earthquake Grass | Seed Bomb Mountain | Rock Slide Road | Earthquake Shallow water | Hydro Pump Snow | Blizzard Tall grass | Seed Bomb Electric Terrain | Thunderbolt Grassy Terrain | Energy Ball Misty Terrain | Moonblast In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Selected move -------------- | ------------------ Courtyard | Tri Attack Crystal | Rock Slide Gateway | Hydro Pump Magma | Rock Slide Main Street | Tri Attack Neon | Tri Attack Stargazer | Rock Slide Sunny Park | Seed Bomb Sunset | Earthquake Waterfall | Seed Bomb This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

charge.descES: Recarga energía para potenciar el siguiente movimiento de tipo Eléctrico. También sube la Defensa Especial.
charge.descEN: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
charge.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

taunt.descES: Enfurece al objetivo para que solo use movimientos de ataque durante tres turnos.
taunt.descEN: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
taunt.efectoMovEN: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging. Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used. Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

helping-hand.descES: El usuario ayuda a un aliado reforzando la potencia de su ataque.
helping-hand.descEN: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.
helping-hand.efectoMovEN: Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

trick.descES: Engaña al objetivo desprevenido e intercambia objetos.
trick.descEN: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
trick.efectoMovEN: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

role-play.descES: Imita al objetivo por completo y copia su habilidad.
role-play.descEN: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.
role-play.efectoMovEN: User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

wish.descES: Restaura en el siguiente turno la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario o se los pasa al Pokémon que lo sustituye.
wish.descEN: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
wish.efectoMovEN: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

assist.descES: Usa un movimiento de un miembro del equipo elegido al azar.
assist.descEN: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.
assist.efectoMovEN: Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail. This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

ingrain.descES: Echa raíces para recuperar PS en cada turno, pero impide el relevo.
ingrain.descEN: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
ingrain.efectoMovEN: Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them. Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise. The user may still use U-turn to leave the field. This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

superpower.descES: Ataque de gran potencia, pero que reduce el Ataque y la Defensa del agresor.
superpower.descEN: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
superpower.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

magic-coat.descES: Barrera capaz de devolver al agresor movimientos como Drenadoras y otros que alteran el estado o las características.
magic-coat.descEN: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
magic-coat.efectoMovEN: The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user. Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected. Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

recycle.descES: Recicla y así recupera un objeto equipado de un solo uso que ya haya sido empleado durante el combate.
recycle.descEN: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
recycle.efectoMovEN: User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails. Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

revenge.descES: Ataque que produce el doble de daño si el usuario resulta herido en el mismo turno.
revenge.descEN: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
revenge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

brick-break.descES: Potente ataque que también es capaz de destruir barreras como Pantalla de Luz y Reflejo.
brick-break.descEN: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
brick-break.efectoMovEN: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

yawn.descES: Gran bostezo que induce al sueño al objetivo en el siguiente turno.
yawn.descEN: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
yawn.efectoMovEN: Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail. If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail. Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

knock-off.descES: Impide al objetivo usar el objeto que lleva durante el combate. La potencia del movimiento se multiplica si el objetivo lleva un objeto.
knock-off.descEN: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.
knock-off.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

endeavor.descES: Reduce los PS del objetivo para que igualen a los del atacante.
endeavor.descEN: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
endeavor.efectoMovEN: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

eruption.descES: Furia explosiva. Cuanto menor sea el número de PS del usuario, menos daño hará el ataque.
eruption.descEN: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
eruption.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

skill-swap.descES: Usa el poder psíquico para intercambiar habilidades con el objetivo.
skill-swap.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
skill-swap.efectoMovEN: User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

imprison.descES: Impide a los contrincantes usar ataques conocidos por el usuario durante el combate.
imprison.descEN: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
imprison.efectoMovEN: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.

refresh.descES: Descansa para curar parálisis, envenenamiento o quemaduras.
refresh.descEN: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.
refresh.efectoMovEN: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

grudge.descES: Si el usuario se debilita al recibir un ataque, todos los PP de este último ataque serán eliminados.
grudge.descEN: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.
grudge.efectoMovEN: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

snatch.descES: Roba el efecto de los movimientos de curación o de cambio de características que se usen.
snatch.descEN: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.
snatch.efectoMovEN: The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag. If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect. If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

secret-power.descES: Ataque cuyos efectos secundarios varían según el entorno de combate.
secret-power.descEN: The additional effects of this attack depend upon where it was used.
secret-power.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Building | Paralyzes target Cave | Makes target flinch Deep water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Desert | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Grass | Puts target to sleep Mountain | Makes target flinch Road | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Shallow water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Snow | Freezes target Tall grass | Puts target to sleep In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Courtyard | Paralyzes target Crystal | Makes target flinch Gateway | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Magma | Makes target flinch Main Street | Paralyzes target Neon | Paralyzes target Stargazer | Makes target flinch Sunny Park | Puts target to sleep Sunset | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Waterfall | Puts target to sleep

dive.descES: El usuario se sumerge en el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
dive.descEN: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
dive.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Surf, and Whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

arm-thrust.descES: Fuertes empujones que golpean de dos a cinco veces seguidas.
arm-thrust.descEN: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.
arm-thrust.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

camouflage.descES: Modifica el tipo del Pokémon según el terreno de combate donde esté.
camouflage.descEN: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.
camouflage.efectoMovEN: User’s type changes according to the terrain. Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Building | Normal Cave | Rock Desert | Ground Grass | Grass Mountain | Rock Ocean | Water Pond | Water Road | Ground Snow | Ice Tall grass | Grass In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Courtyard | Normal Crystal | Rock Gateway | Water Magma | Rock Main Street | Normal Neon | Normal Stargazer | Rock Sunny Park | Grass Sunset | Ground Waterfall | Grass

tail-glow.descES: Se concentra en una ráfaga de luz que sube muchísimo el Ataque Especial.
tail-glow.descEN: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically boosting its Sp. Atk stat.
tail-glow.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.

luster-purge.descES: Fogonazo de luz que puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
luster-purge.descEN: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
luster-purge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

mist-ball.descES: Banco de niebla que puede bajar el Ataque Especial del objetivo.
mist-ball.descEN: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
mist-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

feather-dance.descES: Envuelve al objetivo con un manto de plumas para reducir mucho su Ataque.
feather-dance.descEN: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
feather-dance.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

teeter-dance.descES: Danza histérica que confunde a los Pokémon que están alrededor del usuario.
teeter-dance.descEN: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

blaze-kick.descES: Patada que suele ser un golpe crítico y puede causar quemaduras.
blaze-kick.descEN: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
blaze-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to burn the target.

mud-sport.descES: El usuario esparce lodo a su alrededor, lo que debilita los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico durante cinco turnos.
mud-sport.descEN: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.
mud-sport.efectoMovEN: Electric moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

ice-ball.descES: El atacante rueda contra el objetivo durante cinco turnos, cada vez con mayor fuerza.
ice-ball.descEN: The user attacks the target for five turns. The move’s power increases each time it hits.
ice-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

needle-arm.descES: Pega con brazos de pinchos y puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.
needle-arm.descEN: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This may also make the target flinch.
needle-arm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

slack-off.descES: El usuario se relaja y restaura la mitad de sus PS máximos.
slack-off.descEN: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
slack-off.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP.

hyper-voice.descES: Grito desgarrador que inflige daño al objetivo.
hyper-voice.descEN: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

poison-fang.descES: Colmillos tóxicos que pueden envenenar gravemente al objetivo.
poison-fang.descEN: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
poison-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to badly poison the target.

crush-claw.descES: Hace trizas al objetivo con garras afiladas y puede bajar su Defensa.
crush-claw.descEN: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
crush-claw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

blast-burn.descES: Explosión de fuego. El atacante debe descansar el siguiente turno.
blast-burn.descEN: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
blast-burn.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

hydro-cannon.descES: Disparo de agua. El atacante debe descansar el siguiente turno.
hydro-cannon.descEN: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.
hydro-cannon.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

meteor-mash.descES: Puñetazo que impacta como un meteorito y puede subir el Ataque del agresor.
meteor-mash.descEN: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also boost the user’s Attack stat.
meteor-mash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

astonish.descES: Lanza un grito tan tremendo que impresiona y puede amedrentar al objetivo.
astonish.descEN: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.
astonish.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

weather-ball.descES: El tipo y fuerza del ataque varían según el tiempo que haga.
weather-ball.descEN: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.
weather-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

aromatherapy.descES: Cura todos los problemas de estado del equipo con un suave aroma.
aromatherapy.descEN: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status conditions affecting the user's party.
aromatherapy.efectoMovEN: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

fake-tears.descES: Lágrimas de cocodrilo que bajan mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
fake-tears.descEN: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
fake-tears.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

air-cutter.descES: Viento cortante que azota. Suele ser un golpe crítico.
air-cutter.descEN: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
air-cutter.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

overheat.descES: Ataque en toda regla que baja mucho el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.
overheat.descEN: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
overheat.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

odor-sleuth.descES: Permite atacar con cualquier movimiento a objetivos de tipo Fantasma y golpear a Pokémon evasivos.
odor-sleuth.descEN: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
odor-sleuth.efectoMovEN: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

rock-tomb.descES: Tira rocas que detienen al objetivo y bajan su Velocidad.
rock-tomb.descEN: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.
rock-tomb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

silver-wind.descES: Fuerte viento con polvo de escamas. Puede subir todas las características de quien lo usa.
silver-wind.descEN: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. This may also raise all the user’s stats.
silver-wind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

metal-sound.descES: Horrible chirrido metálico que baja mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
metal-sound.descEN: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
metal-sound.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

grass-whistle.descES: Agradable melodía que adormece al objetivo.
grass-whistle.descEN: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

tickle.descES: Hace reír al objetivo para bajar su Ataque y Defensa.
tickle.descEN: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
tickle.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

cosmic-power.descES: Sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial propias con energía mística.
cosmic-power.descEN: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
cosmic-power.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

water-spout.descES: Chorro de agua. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, menos dañino será.
water-spout.descEN: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
water-spout.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

signal-beam.descES: Ataca con un rayo de luz siniestro. Puede confundir al objetivo.
signal-beam.descEN: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This may also confuse the target.
signal-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

shadow-punch.descES: Puñetazo ineludible procedente de las sombras.
shadow-punch.descEN: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.
shadow-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

extrasensory.descES: Emite una energía muy extraña que puede amedrentar al objetivo.
extrasensory.descEN: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.
extrasensory.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

sky-uppercut.descEN: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
sky-uppercut.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

sand-tomb.descES: Enreda al objetivo en un remolino de arena de cuatro a cinco turnos.
sand-tomb.descEN: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
sand-tomb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

sheer-cold.descES: Debilita al objetivo de un solo golpe. Si lo usa un Pokémon que no sea de tipo Hielo, es difícil que acierte.
sheer-cold.descEN: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
sheer-cold.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

muddy-water.descES: Ataque con agua lodosa que puede bajar la Precisión del equipo rival.
muddy-water.descEN: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.
muddy-water.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

bullet-seed.descES: Dispara rápido de dos a cinco ráfagas de semillas de manera consecutiva.
bullet-seed.descEN: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
bullet-seed.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

aerial-ace.descES: El usuario lanza un ataque muy rápido e ineludible.
aerial-ace.descEN: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
aerial-ace.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

icicle-spear.descES: Ataca lanzando de dos a cinco ráfagas consecutivas de carámbanos.
icicle-spear.descEN: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
icicle-spear.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

iron-defense.descES: Fortalece el cuerpo como si fuera de hierro y sube mucho la Defensa.
iron-defense.descEN: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
iron-defense.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

block.descES: Le corta el paso al objetivo para que no pueda escapar.
block.descEN: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
block.efectoMovEN: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

howl.descES: Aullido que sube el ánimo y aumenta el Ataque del equipo.
howl.descEN: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
howl.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

dragon-claw.descES: Araña al objetivo con garras afiladas.
dragon-claw.descEN: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

frenzy-plant.descES: Golpea con una enorme planta. Quien lo usa no puede moverse en el siguiente turno.
frenzy-plant.descEN: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
frenzy-plant.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

bulk-up.descES: Robustece el cuerpo para subir el Ataque y la Defensa.
bulk-up.descEN: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
bulk-up.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

bounce.descES: El usuario bota en el primer turno y golpea al objetivo en el segundo y puede llegar a paralizarlo.
bounce.descEN: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
bounce.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

mud-shot.descES: El usuario lanza lodo al objetivo y reduce su Velocidad.
mud-shot.descEN: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
mud-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

poison-tail.descES: Puede envenenar y dar un golpe crítico.
poison-tail.descEN: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.
poison-tail.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

covet.descES: Se acerca con ternura al objetivo, pero le ataca y le roba el objeto que lleve.
covet.descEN: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
covet.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

volt-tackle.descES: Quien lo usa electrifica su cuerpo para luego atacar. Se hiere mucho a sí mismo, pero puede paralizar al objetivo.
volt-tackle.descEN: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
volt-tackle.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

magical-leaf.descES: Esparce extrañas hojas que persiguen al objetivo. No se puede esquivar.
magical-leaf.descEN: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
magical-leaf.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

water-sport.descES: Empapa el terreno con agua, lo que debilita los movimientos de tipo Fuego durante cinco turnos.
water-sport.descEN: The user soaks the battlefield with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for five turns.
water-sport.efectoMovEN: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

calm-mind.descES: Aumenta la concentración y calma el espíritu para subir el Ataque Especial y la Defensa Especial.
calm-mind.descEN: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
calm-mind.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

leaf-blade.descES: Acuchilla con una hoja fina. Suele dar un golpe crítico.
leaf-blade.descEN: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
leaf-blade.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

dragon-dance.descES: Danza mística que sube el Ataque y la Velocidad.
dragon-dance.descEN: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
dragon-dance.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

rock-blast.descES: Lanza pedruscos al objetivo de dos a cinco veces consecutivas.
rock-blast.descEN: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
rock-blast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

shock-wave.descES: Ataque eléctrico muy rápido e ineludible.
shock-wave.descEN: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.
shock-wave.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

water-pulse.descES: Ataca con un potente chorro de agua. Puede confundir al objetivo.
water-pulse.descEN: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
water-pulse.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

doom-desire.descES: Concentra un haz de luz y ataca dos turnos después.
doom-desire.descEN: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
doom-desire.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

psycho-boost.descES: Ataque en toda regla que baja mucho el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.
psycho-boost.descEN: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
psycho-boost.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

roost.descES: Aterriza sobre la superficie para descansar. Recupera hasta la mitad del total de sus PS.
roost.descEN: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.
roost.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

gravity.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se anulan los movimientos que alzan el vuelo y los Pokémon de tipo Volador o que levitan son vulnerables a movimientos de tipo Tierra.
gravity.descEN: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
gravity.efectoMovEN: For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop. Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes. Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect. *Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

miracle-eye.descES: Permite atacar con cualquier movimiento a objetivos de tipo Siniestro y golpear a Pokémon evasivos.
miracle-eye.descEN: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
miracle-eye.efectoMovEN: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

wake-up-slap.descES: Inflige gran daño a objetivos dormidos. Sin embargo, los bofetones también los despiertan.
wake-up-slap.descEN: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. This also wakes the target up, however.
wake-up-slap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

hammer-arm.descES: Gira con fuerza el puño y da un gran golpe. No obstante, baja la Velocidad.
hammer-arm.descEN: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
hammer-arm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

gyro-ball.descES: Embiste al objetivo con un potente ataque giratorio. Cuanto más lento es el usuario, más daño causa.
gyro-ball.descEN: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
gyro-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

healing-wish.descES: El Pokémon cae debilitado, pero su sustituto recupera su estado y los PS.
healing-wish.descEN: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.
healing-wish.efectoMovEN: User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

brine.descES: Si al objetivo le queda la mitad o menos de sus PS, el ataque será el doble de fuerte.
brine.descEN: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
brine.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

natural-gift.descES: La baya que lleva presta su fuerza para atacar. El tipo de ataque y su fuerza dependen de la baya.
natural-gift.descEN: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines the move’s type and power.
natural-gift.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

feint.descES: Permite golpear a objetivos que han utilizado movimientos como Protección o Detección y anula sus efectos.
feint.descEN: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
feint.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

pluck.descES: Picotea al objetivo. Si este sostiene una baya, la picotea también y obtiene sus efectos.
pluck.descEN: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
pluck.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

tailwind.descES: Crea un fuerte remolino que aumenta la Velocidad de los Pokémon de tu equipo durante cuatro turnos.
tailwind.descEN: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
tailwind.efectoMovEN: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

acupressure.descES: Aplica presión en puntos clave del cuerpo para potenciar mucho una de sus características.
acupressure.descEN: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
acupressure.efectoMovEN: Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail. If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

metal-burst.descES: Devuelve al rival el último ataque recibido, pero con mucha más fuerza.
metal-burst.descEN: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
metal-burst.efectoMovEN: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

u-turn.descES: Tras atacar, el usuario vuelve a toda prisa para dar paso a otro Pokémon del equipo.
u-turn.descEN: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
u-turn.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

close-combat.descES: Lucha abiertamente contra el objetivo sin protegerse. También reduce la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del usuario.
close-combat.descEN: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
close-combat.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

payback.descES: El usuario contraataca con el doble de fuerza si el objetivo usa un movimiento antes.
payback.descEN: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.
payback.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

assurance.descES: Si el objetivo ya ha sufrido daño en ese turno, la fuerza del ataque se duplica.
assurance.descEN: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
assurance.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

embargo.descES: Impide al objetivo usar el objeto que lleva durante cinco turnos. Su Entrenador tampoco puede usar objetos con él.
embargo.descEN: This move prevents the target from using its held item for five turns. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
embargo.efectoMovEN: Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail. This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

fling.descES: El usuario lanza contra el objetivo el objeto que lleva. La fuerza del ataque y su efecto varían según el objeto.
fling.descEN: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.
fling.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail. This move ignores Sticky Hold. If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.

psycho-shift.descES: Usa su poder mental para transferir al objetivo sus problemas de estado.
psycho-shift.descEN: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.
psycho-shift.efectoMovEN: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.

trump-card.descES: Cuantos menos PP tenga el movimiento, mayor será la fuerza para atacar.
trump-card.descEN: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.
trump-card.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200 If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

heal-block.descES: Impide al objetivo usar movimientos, habilidades y objetos equipados que recuperan PS durante cinco turnos.
heal-block.descEN: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.
heal-block.efectoMovEN: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.

wring-out.descES: Estruja con fuerza al objetivo. Cuantos más PS tenga el objetivo, más fuerza tendrá el ataque.
wring-out.descEN: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power.
wring-out.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

power-trick.descES: Usa sus poderes mentales para intercambiar sus características de Ataque y Defensa.
power-trick.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
power-trick.efectoMovEN: The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

gastro-acid.descES: El usuario arroja sus jugos biliares al objetivo, lo que anula el efecto de la habilidad en uso.
gastro-acid.descEN: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
gastro-acid.efectoMovEN: The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

lucky-chant.descES: Lanza al cielo un conjuro que protege a todo su equipo de golpes críticos durante cinco turnos.
lucky-chant.descEN: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for five turns.
lucky-chant.efectoMovEN: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.

me-first.descES: Se adelanta al movimiento que pretende usar el objetivo y lo lanza antes con más fuerza. Si el usuario es más lento, falla.
me-first.descEN: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target’s intended move with greater power. This move fails if it isn’t used first.
me-first.efectoMovEN: If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power. If the target moves before the user, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

copycat.descES: Imita el movimiento usado justo antes. El movimiento falla si no se ha usado aún ninguno.
copycat.descEN: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
copycat.efectoMovEN: Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user. This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

power-swap.descES: El usuario emplea su poder mental para intercambiar los cambios en el Ataque y Ataque Especial con el objetivo.
power-swap.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
power-swap.efectoMovEN: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

guard-swap.descES: El usuario emplea su poder mental para intercambiar los cambios en la Defensa y Defensa Especial con el objetivo.
guard-swap.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
guard-swap.efectoMovEN: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

punishment.descES: La fuerza del ataque aumenta cuanto más se ha fortalecido el objetivo con cambios de características.
punishment.descEN: The more the target has powered up with stat changes, the greater the move’s power.
punishment.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

last-resort.descES: Este movimiento solo puede utilizarse tras haber usado al menos una vez todos los demás conocidos por el Pokémon.
last-resort.descEN: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
last-resort.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

worry-seed.descES: Planta una semilla en el objetivo que le causa pesar. Sustituye la habilidad del objetivo por Insomnio y le impide dormirse.
worry-seed.descEN: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
worry-seed.efectoMovEN: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.

sucker-punch.descES: Permite atacar con prioridad. Falla si el objetivo no está preparando ningún ataque.
