sucker-punch.descEN: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
sucker-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

toxic-spikes.descES: Lanza una trampa de púas tóxicas a los pies del objetivo. El veneno afecta a los Pokémon oponentes que entran en combate.
toxic-spikes.descEN: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
toxic-spikes.efectoMovEN: Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

heart-swap.descES: Usa la fuerza mental para intercambiar con el objetivo los cambios en las características.
heart-swap.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
heart-swap.efectoMovEN: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

aqua-ring.descES: Un manto de agua cubre al Pokémon que lo usa. Recupera algunos PS en cada turno.
aqua-ring.descEN: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
aqua-ring.efectoMovEN: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

magnet-rise.descES: Levita gracias a un campo magnético generado por electricidad durante cinco turnos.
magnet-rise.descEN: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
magnet-rise.efectoMovEN: For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves. If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail. This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

flare-blitz.descES: El Pokémon se cubre de llamas y carga contra el objetivo, aunque él también recibe daño. Puede quemar.
flare-blitz.descEN: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.
flare-blitz.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

force-palm.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una onda de choque y puede llegar a paralizarlo.
force-palm.descEN: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
force-palm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

aura-sphere.descES: Libera, desde su interior, una inmensa descarga de aura. Es infalible.
aura-sphere.descEN: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
aura-sphere.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

rock-polish.descES: Reduce la resistencia puliendo su cuerpo. Aumenta mucho la Velocidad.
rock-polish.descEN: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.
rock-polish.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

poison-jab.descES: Pincha al objetivo con un tentáculo o brazo envenenado. Puede llegar a envenenar al objetivo.
poison-jab.descEN: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
poison-jab.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

dark-pulse.descES: Libera una horrible aura llena de malos pensamientos que puede amedrentar al objetivo.
dark-pulse.descEN: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
dark-pulse.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

night-slash.descES: Ataca al objetivo a la primera oportunidad. Suele ser crítico.
night-slash.descEN: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
night-slash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

aqua-tail.descES: Ataca agitando la cola como si fuera una ola rabiosa en una tormenta devastadora.
aqua-tail.descEN: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

seed-bomb.descES: Lanza al objetivo una descarga de semillas explosivas desde arriba.
seed-bomb.descEN: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

air-slash.descES: Ataca con un viento afilado que incluso corta el aire. También puede amedrentar al objetivo.
air-slash.descEN: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
air-slash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

x-scissor.descES: Cruza las guadañas o las garras para atacar al objetivo como si fueran unas tijeras.
x-scissor.descEN: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

bug-buzz.descES: El usuario crea una onda sónica dañina moviendo su cuerpo que también puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
bug-buzz.descEN: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
bug-buzz.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

dragon-pulse.descES: Abre mucho la boca y libera una onda de choque que ataca al objetivo.
dragon-pulse.descEN: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

dragon-rush.descES: Ataca de forma brutal mientras intimida al objetivo. También puede amedrentarlo.
dragon-rush.descEN: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
dragon-rush.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

power-gem.descES: Ataca con un rayo de luz que centellea como si lo formaran miles de joyas.
power-gem.descEN: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

drain-punch.descES: Un golpe que drena energía. El Pokémon recupera la mitad de los PS arrebatados al objetivo.
drain-punch.descEN: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
drain-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

vacuum-wave.descES: Gira los puños y libera una onda de vacío contra el objetivo. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
vacuum-wave.descEN: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

focus-blast.descES: Agudiza la concentración mental y libera su poder. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
focus-blast.descEN: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
focus-blast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

energy-ball.descES: Aúna fuerzas de la naturaleza y libera su ataque. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
energy-ball.descEN: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
energy-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

brave-bird.descES: Pliega sus alas y ataca con un vuelo rasante. El Pokémon que lo usa también resulta seriamente dañado.
brave-bird.descEN: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
brave-bird.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

earth-power.descES: La tierra a los pies del objetivo erupciona violentamente. Puede disminuir la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
earth-power.descEN: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
earth-power.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

switcheroo.descES: Intercambia con el objetivo los objetos que llevan tan rápido que es imposible verlo a simple vista.
switcheroo.descEN: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
switcheroo.efectoMovEN: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

giga-impact.descES: El usuario carga contra el objetivo con toda la fuerza que tiene y descansa durante el siguiente turno.
giga-impact.descEN: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
giga-impact.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

nasty-plot.descES: Estimula su cerebro pensando en cosas malas. Aumenta mucho el Ataque Especial.
nasty-plot.descEN: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
nasty-plot.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

bullet-punch.descES: Ataca con fuertes puñetazos tan rápidos como proyectiles. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
bullet-punch.descEN: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

avalanche.descES: Este ataque inflige el doble de daño a un objetivo que haya golpeado al usuario en ese mismo turno.
avalanche.descEN: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
avalanche.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

ice-shard.descES: Crea bolas de hielo y las lanza a gran velocidad. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
ice-shard.descEN: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

shadow-claw.descES: Ataca con una garra afilada hecha de sombras. Suele ser crítico.
shadow-claw.descEN: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
shadow-claw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

thunder-fang.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos electrificados y puede hacer que se amedrente o se paralice.
thunder-fang.descEN: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
thunder-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

ice-fang.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos helados y puede hacer que se amedrente o se congele.
ice-fang.descEN: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
ice-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

fire-fang.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos en llamas y puede hacer que se amedrente o sufra quemaduras.
fire-fang.descEN: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
fire-fang.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

shadow-sneak.descES: Extiende su sombra y ataca al objetivo por la espalda. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
shadow-sneak.descEN: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

mud-bomb.descES: Ataca lanzando una compacta bola de fango. Puede bajar la Precisión del objetivo.
mud-bomb.descEN: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
mud-bomb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

psycho-cut.descES: Ataca al objetivo con cuchillas formadas por energía psíquica. Suele ser crítico.
psycho-cut.descEN: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
psycho-cut.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

zen-headbutt.descES: Concentra su energía psíquica en la cabeza para golpear. Puede hacer que el objetivo se amedrente.
zen-headbutt.descEN: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
zen-headbutt.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

mirror-shot.descES: El usuario libera un haz de energía desde su pulido cuerpo. Puede bajar la Precisión.
mirror-shot.descEN: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
mirror-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

flash-cannon.descES: El usuario concentra toda la luz del cuerpo y la libera. Puede bajar la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
flash-cannon.descEN: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
flash-cannon.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

rock-climb.descES: Ataca con una gran embestida. Puede confundir al objetivo.
rock-climb.descEN: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This may also confuse the target.
rock-climb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

defog.descES: Potente viento que barre el reflejo o la pantalla de luz creada por el objetivo. También puede reducir su Evasión.
defog.descEN: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
defog.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field. If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

trick-room.descES: Crea un espacio extraño en el que los Pokémon lentos se mueven primero durante cinco turnos.
trick-room.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
trick-room.efectoMovEN: For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect. Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

draco-meteor.descES: Hace que grandes cometas caigan del cielo sobre el objetivo. Baja mucho el Ataque Especial del que lo usa.
draco-meteor.descEN: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
draco-meteor.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

discharge.descES: Una deslumbradora onda eléctrica afecta a los Pokémon que hay combatiendo alrededor. Puede paralizar.
discharge.descEN: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
discharge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

lava-plume.descES: Un infierno de llamas daña a los Pokémon adyacentes en combate. Puede quemar.
lava-plume.descEN: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
lava-plume.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

leaf-storm.descES: Envuelve al objetivo con una lluvia de hojas afiladas, pero reduce mucho su Ataque Especial.
leaf-storm.descEN: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
leaf-storm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

power-whip.descES: El usuario agita violentamente sus lianas o tentáculos para golpear al objetivo.
power-whip.descEN: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

rock-wrecker.descES: Lanza una piedra enorme contra el objetivo, pero tiene que descansar el siguiente turno.
rock-wrecker.descEN: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
rock-wrecker.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

cross-poison.descES: Tajo que puede envenenar al objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
cross-poison.descEN: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cross-poison.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

gunk-shot.descES: Lanza contra el objetivo basura asquerosa y puede envenenarlo.
gunk-shot.descEN: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
gunk-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

iron-head.descES: Ataca con su dura cabeza de hierro. Puede hacer que el objetivo se amedrente.
iron-head.descEN: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
iron-head.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

magnet-bomb.descES: Lanza unas bombas de hierro que se pegan al adversario. No se puede esquivar.
magnet-bomb.descEN: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.
magnet-bomb.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

stone-edge.descES: Clava piedras muy afiladas al objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
stone-edge.descEN: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
stone-edge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

captivate.descES: Si el objetivo es del sexo opuesto, queda embelesado y baja mucho su Ataque Especial.
captivate.descEN: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.
captivate.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

stealth-rock.descES: Una trampa de rocas que flota en el aire y daña a los objetivos que entran en combate.
stealth-rock.descEN: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
stealth-rock.efectoMovEN: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

grass-knot.descES: Enreda al objetivo con hierba y lo derriba. Cuanto más pesado es el objetivo, más daño inflige.
grass-knot.descEN: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
grass-knot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

chatter.descES: Ataca con una onda de sonido muy ruidosa compuesta por palabras y confunde al objetivo.
chatter.descEN: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
chatter.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion. If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

judgment.descES: Emite incontables haces de luz. El tipo del movimiento varía según la tabla que lleve el usuario.
judgment.descEN: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type changes depending on the kind of plate held by the user.
judgment.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

bug-bite.descES: Pica al objetivo. Si el objetivo lleva una baya, el usuario se la come y se beneficia de su efecto.
bug-bite.descEN: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
bug-bite.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

charge-beam.descES: Lanza un rayo eléctrico contra el objetivo. Puede subir el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.
charge-beam.descEN: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
charge-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

wood-hammer.descES: Arremete contra el objetivo con su robusto cuerpo. El agresor también sufre bastante daño.
wood-hammer.descEN: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
wood-hammer.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

aqua-jet.descES: Ataque de una rapidez espeluznante. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
aqua-jet.descEN: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

attack-order.descES: El usuario llama a sus súbditos para que ataquen al objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
attack-order.descEN: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
attack-order.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

defend-order.descES: El usuario llama a sus súbditos para que formen un escudo viviente. Sube la Defensa y la Defensa Especial.
defend-order.descEN: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
defend-order.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

heal-order.descES: El usuario llama a sus súbditos para que lo curen. Recupera hasta la mitad de los PS máximos.
heal-order.descEN: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
heal-order.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half its max HP.

head-smash.descES: El usuario arriesga su vida y lanza un cabezazo con toda su fuerza. El agresor resulta seriamente dañado.
head-smash.descEN: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
head-smash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

double-hit.descES: Golpea al objetivo dos veces seguidas con la cola u otras partes de su cuerpo.
double-hit.descEN: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.
double-hit.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

roar-of-time.descES: Ataca al objetivo usando tal energía que el tiempo se distorsiona. El usuario descansa el siguiente turno.
roar-of-time.descEN: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.
roar-of-time.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

spacial-rend.descES: Desgarra al objetivo y el espacio a su alrededor. Suele ser crítico.
spacial-rend.descEN: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
spacial-rend.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

lunar-dance.descES: El usuario se debilita, pero el Pokémon que lo sustituye recupera su estado, los PS y los PP.
lunar-dance.descEN: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP and PP restored and its status conditions cured.
lunar-dance.efectoMovEN: User faints. Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.

crush-grip.descES: Estruja al objetivo con gran fuerza. Cuantos más PS le queden al objetivo, más fuerte será el ataque.
crush-grip.descEN: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
crush-grip.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

magma-storm.descES: El objetivo queda atrapado en una tormenta de fuego que dura de cuatro a cinco turnos.
magma-storm.descEN: The user traps the target inside a maelstrom of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
magma-storm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

dark-void.descES: El objetivo es enviado a un mundo de tinieblas que lo hace dormir.
dark-void.descEN: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.

seed-flare.descES: Una onda de choque se libera del cuerpo. Puede bajar mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
seed-flare.descEN: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
seed-flare.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

ominous-wind.descES: Produce un viento horripilante. Puede subir de golpe todas las características del usuario.
ominous-wind.descEN: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
ominous-wind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

shadow-force.descES: En el primer turno, desaparece. En el segundo, golpea al objetivo aunque se esté protegiendo.
shadow-force.descEN: The user disappears on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
shadow-force.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

hone-claws.descES: El usuario se afila las garras para aumentar su Ataque y Precisión.
hone-claws.descEN: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
hone-claws.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.

wide-guard.descES: Bloquea los ataques de objetivo múltiple lanzados contra tu equipo durante un turno.
wide-guard.descEN: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
wide-guard.efectoMovEN: Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

guard-split.descES: El usuario emplea sus poderes para hacer la media de su Defensa y Defensa Especial con las de su objetivo y compartirlas.
guard-split.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
guard-split.efectoMovEN: Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way.

power-split.descES: El usuario emplea sus poderes para hacer la media de su Ataque y Ataque Especial con los de su objetivo y compartirlos.
power-split.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
power-split.efectoMovEN: Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way. This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as Flower Gift during Sunny Day.

wonder-room.descES: Crea una zona misteriosa donde se intercambian la Defensa y la Defensa Especial de todos los Pokémon durante cinco turnos.
wonder-room.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
wonder-room.efectoMovEN: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.

psyshock.descES: Crea una onda psíquica que causa daño físico al objetivo.
psyshock.descEN: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
psyshock.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

venoshock.descES: Cubre al objetivo con un líquido venenoso. El daño será doble si este ya está envenenado.
venoshock.descEN: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

autotomize.descES: El usuario se desprende de partes prescindibles de su cuerpo para hacerse más ligero y aumentar mucho su Velocidad.
autotomize.descEN: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
autotomize.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.

rage-powder.descES: Usa un polvo que irrita y centra en el usuario la atención y los ataques de los rivales.
rage-powder.descEN: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
rage-powder.efectoMovEN: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

telekinesis.descES: El usuario emplea su poder mental para hacer flotar al objetivo, y lo convierte en un blanco fácil durante tres turnos.
telekinesis.descEN: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
telekinesis.efectoMovEN: For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to Ground damage. Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect. This effect is removed by Gravity. If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.

magic-room.descES: Crea un espacio misterioso que inutiliza todos los objetos de los Pokémon durante cinco turnos.
magic-room.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
magic-room.efectoMovEN: For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items.

smack-down.descES: Ataca lanzando una piedra o un proyectil. Si el objetivo está en el aire, lo estrella contra el suelo.
smack-down.descEN: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.
smack-down.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage. If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

storm-throw.descES: Lanza un golpe devastador. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
storm-throw.descEN: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
storm-throw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

flame-burst.descES: Golpea al objetivo con una llamarada que afecta también a los Pokémon adyacentes.
flame-burst.descEN: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.
flame-burst.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If this move successfully hits the target, any Pokémon adjacent to the target are damaged for 1/16 their max HP.

sludge-wave.descES: Una onda tóxica que daña a los Pokémon de alrededor. Puede envenenar.
sludge-wave.descEN: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.
sludge-wave.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

quiver-dance.descES: Danza mística que sube el Ataque Especial, la Defensa Especial y la Velocidad.
quiver-dance.descEN: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
quiver-dance.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

heavy-slam.descES: El usuario golpea con todo su cuerpo. Cuanto mayor sea su peso comparado con el del objetivo, más daño causará.
heavy-slam.descEN: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
heavy-slam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

synchronoise.descES: Una extraña onda que daña a todos los Pokémon adyacentes del mismo tipo que el que la ejecuta.
synchronoise.descEN: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.
synchronoise.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Only Pokémon that share a type with the user will take damage from this move.

electro-ball.descES: Lanza una bola eléctrica. Cuanto mayor sea la Velocidad del usuario en comparación con la del objetivo, mayor será el daño causado.
electro-ball.descEN: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
electro-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150. User’s Speed | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s Speed | 60 Up to 3× the target’s Speed | 80 Up to 4× the target’s Speed | 120 More than 4× the target’s Speed | 150

soak.descES: Potente lluvia que transforma al objetivo en un Pokémon de tipo Agua.
soak.descEN: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.
soak.efectoMovEN: Changes the target to pure Water-type until it leaves the field. If the target has Multitype, this move will fail.

flame-charge.descES: Llamas que golpean al objetivo y aumentan la Velocidad del atacante.
flame-charge.descEN: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
flame-charge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

coil.descES: El usuario se concentra, lo que le permite aumentar su Ataque, Defensa y Precisión.
coil.descEN: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
coil.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

low-sweep.descES: Ataque rápido dirigido a los pies del objetivo que le hace perder Velocidad.
low-sweep.descEN: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
low-sweep.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

acid-spray.descES: Ataca con un líquido corrosivo que reduce mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
acid-spray.descEN: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
acid-spray.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

foul-play.descES: El usuario emplea la fuerza del objetivo para atacarlo. Cuanto mayor es el Ataque del objetivo, más daño provoca.
foul-play.descEN: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.
foul-play.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s.

simple-beam.descES: Lanza una onda psíquica que hace que la habilidad del objetivo pase a ser Simple.
simple-beam.descEN: The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target's Ability to Simple.
simple-beam.efectoMovEN: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.

entrainment.descES: Una extraña danza que hace que el usuario y el objetivo tengan la misma habilidad.
entrainment.descEN: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
entrainment.efectoMovEN: Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s. This effect ends when the target leaves battle.

after-you.descES: Si el usuario es el más rápido, permite al objetivo usar un movimiento justo tras él, adelantándose a Pokémon más rápidos.
after-you.descEN: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
after-you.efectoMovEN: The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

round.descES: Un canto que ataca al objetivo. Cuantos más Pokémon lo usan, más aumenta de potencia.
round.descEN: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.
round.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled. After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority. Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

echoed-voice.descES: Un susurro que aumenta de potencia conforme el usuario y otros Pokémon lo van utilizando.
echoed-voice.descEN: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
echoed-voice.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If any friendly Pokémon used this move earlier this turn or on the previous turn, that use’s power is added to this move’s power, to a maximum of 200.

chip-away.descES: Un ataque que busca los puntos débiles del objetivo. El daño infligido no se ve afectado por los cambios en sus características.
chip-away.descEN: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
chip-away.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

clear-smog.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una singular bola de lodo que elimina cualquier cambio en sus características.
clear-smog.descEN: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
clear-smog.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero.

stored-power.descES: Acumula poder para golpear. Cuanto más suban las características del usuario, mayor será el daño.
stored-power.descEN: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
stored-power.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

quick-guard.descES: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados de movimientos con prioridad.
quick-guard.descEN: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
quick-guard.efectoMovEN: Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

ally-switch.descES: Extraño poder que intercambia la posición del usuario con la de un aliado sobre el terreno de combate.
ally-switch.descEN: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
ally-switch.efectoMovEN: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it. If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

scald.descES: Ataca arrojando agua hirviendo al objetivo. Puede causar quemaduras.
scald.descEN: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
scald.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

shell-smash.descES: El usuario rompe su coraza y baja su Defensa y Defensa Especial, pero aumenta mucho su Ataque, Ataque Especial y Velocidad.
shell-smash.descEN: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
shell-smash.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each. Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

heal-pulse.descES: Una onda curativa restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del objetivo.
heal-pulse.descEN: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.
heal-pulse.efectoMovEN: Heals the target for half its max HP.

hex.descES: Ataque que causa un gran daño a los objetivos que sufren problemas de estado.
hex.descEN: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
hex.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

sky-drop.descES: Primer turno: lanza al objetivo al aire. Segundo turno: lo hace caer. Mientras está en el aire, no lo deja moverse.
sky-drop.descEN: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.
sky-drop.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act. On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect. If the target is Flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage. Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect. Gust and Twister will additionally have double power. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during this effect. Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. *Bug*: If Gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

shift-gear.descES: Al hacer girar los engranajes, el usuario mejora su Ataque y aumenta mucho su Velocidad.
shift-gear.descEN: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.
shift-gear.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

circle-throw.descES: Lanza por los aires al objetivo y hace que salga otro Pokémon. Si es uno salvaje, acaba el combate.
circle-throw.descEN: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
circle-throw.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

incinerate.descES: Llamas que golpean a los objetivos adyacentes. Si estos llevan bayas o ciertos objetos, se quemarán y ya no se podrán usar.
incinerate.descEN: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
incinerate.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move.

quash.descES: Consigue que el objetivo sea el último en moverse.
quash.descEN: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
quash.efectoMovEN: Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

acrobatics.descES: Golpea ágilmente. Si el usuario no porta ningún objeto, el objetivo resulta seriamente dañado.
acrobatics.descEN: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
acrobatics.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

reflect-type.descES: Cambia el tipo del Pokémon al mismo tipo que el del objetivo.
reflect-type.descEN: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
reflect-type.efectoMovEN: User’s type changes to match the target’s.

retaliate.descES: Venga a los amigos caídos. Si en el turno anterior han derrotado a alguno, la potencia del ataque aumentará.
retaliate.descEN: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
retaliate.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon fainted on the previous turn, this move has double power.

final-gambit.descES: El usuario se sacrifica causándole un daño al objetivo equivalente a sus propios PS perdidos.
final-gambit.descEN: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.
final-gambit.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.

bestow.descES: Entrega el objeto que lleva al objetivo en caso de que este no tenga ninguno.
bestow.descEN: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
bestow.efectoMovEN: Transfers the user’s held item to the target. If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail.

inferno.descES: Ataca con una gran ráfaga de fuego que causa quemaduras.
inferno.descEN: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
inferno.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

water-pledge.descES: Ataca con columnas de agua. Combinado con Voto Fuego, crea un arcoíris y aumenta su potencia.
water-pledge.descEN: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.
water-pledge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).

fire-pledge.descES: Ataca con columnas de fuego. Combinado con Voto Planta, crea un mar de llamas y aumenta su potencia.
fire-pledge.descEN: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.
fire-pledge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Water Pledge earlier this turn, moves used by any friendly Pokémon have doubled effect chance for four turns (including this one).

grass-pledge.descES: Ataca con columnas de hojas. Combinado con Voto Agua, crea un pantano y aumenta su potencia.
grass-pledge.descEN: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast swamp appears.
grass-pledge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fire Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon will take 1/8 their max HP in damage at the end of every turn for four turns (including this one).

volt-switch.descES: Tras atacar, el usuario vuelve a toda prisa para dar paso a otro Pokémon del equipo.
volt-switch.descEN: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
volt-switch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

struggle-bug.descES: El usuario opone resistencia y ataca a los oponentes. También reduce su Ataque Especial.
struggle-bug.descEN: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.
struggle-bug.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

bulldoze.descES: Sacudida sísmica que afecta a los demás Pokémon adyacentes y también reduce su Velocidad.
bulldoze.descEN: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
bulldoze.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

frost-breath.descES: Quien lo usa ataca lanzando un aliento gélido. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
frost-breath.descEN: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.
frost-breath.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

dragon-tail.descES: Ataca al objetivo y lo obliga a cambiarse por otro Pokémon. Si es uno salvaje, acaba el combate.
dragon-tail.descEN: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
dragon-tail.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

work-up.descES: Quien lo usa se concentra y potencia su Ataque y su Ataque Especial.
work-up.descEN: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
work-up.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

electroweb.descES: Atrapa y ataca a los objetivos con una telaraña eléctrica. También reduce su Velocidad.
electroweb.descEN: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
electroweb.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

wild-charge.descES: Carga eléctrica muy potente que también hiere ligeramente a quien la usa.
wild-charge.descEN: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
wild-charge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

drill-run.descES: El usuario golpea usando su cuerpo como un taladro. Suele ser crítico.
drill-run.descEN: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
drill-run.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

dual-chop.descES: Golpea dos veces seguidas con las partes más recias de su cuerpo.
dual-chop.descEN: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
dual-chop.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

heart-stamp.descES: El usuario despista al objetivo con gestos adorables y aprovecha la ocasión para asestarle un golpe tremendo que puede hacerlo retroceder.
heart-stamp.descEN: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. This may also make the target flinch.
heart-stamp.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

horn-leech.descES: Un golpe que drena energía. El Pokémon recupera la mitad de los PS arrebatados al objetivo.
horn-leech.descEN: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
horn-leech.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

sacred-sword.descES: El usuario ataca con una espada, ignorando cualquier cambio en las características del objetivo.
sacred-sword.descEN: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
sacred-sword.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

razor-shell.descES: Una afilada vieira ataca al objetivo. También puede hacer disminuir su Defensa.
razor-shell.descEN: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
razor-shell.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

heat-crash.descES: El usuario ataca con su cuerpo ardiente. Cuanto mayor sea su peso comparado con el del objetivo, más daño causará.
heat-crash.descEN: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
heat-crash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

leaf-tornado.descES: Tritura con afiladas hojas y puede bajar la Precisión del objetivo.
leaf-tornado.descEN: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
leaf-tornado.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

steamroller.descES: El usuario se hace una bola y arrolla al objetivo con su cuerpo. Puede hacerlo retroceder.
steamroller.descEN: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.
steamroller.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

cotton-guard.descES: Cubre al Pokémon con una madeja protectora. Aumenta muchísimo la Defensa.
cotton-guard.descEN: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.
cotton-guard.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

night-daze.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una onda siniestra. Puede bajar su Precisión.
night-daze.descEN: The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's accuracy.
night-daze.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

psystrike.descES: Crea una onda psíquica que causa daño físico al objetivo.
psystrike.descEN: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
psystrike.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

tail-slap.descES: Golpea con la cola de dos a cinco veces seguidas.
tail-slap.descEN: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.
tail-slap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

hurricane.descES: Golpea al objetivo con un fuerte torbellino que envuelve al rival y puede confundirlo.
hurricane.descEN: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
hurricane.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

head-charge.descES: Propina un tremendo cabezazo. También daña al usuario un poco.
head-charge.descEN: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.
head-charge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

gear-grind.descES: Rota dos engranajes de hierro sobre el objetivo. Golpea dos veces.
gear-grind.descEN: The user attacks by throwing steel gears at its target twice.
gear-grind.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

searing-shot.descES: Un infierno de llamas daña a los Pokémon adyacentes en combate. Puede quemar.
searing-shot.descEN: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
searing-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

techno-blast.descES: Ataca al objetivo con un gran láser. El tipo del ataque lo determina el cartucho que porta el usuario.
techno-blast.descEN: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move’s type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
techno-blast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

relic-song.descES: Ataca conmoviendo a los rivales de alrededor con un antiguo canto. Puede dormirlos.
relic-song.descEN: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.
relic-song.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to put the target to sleep. If the user is a Meloetta, it will toggle between Aria and Pirouette Forme.

secret-sword.descES: Ensarta al objetivo con un largo cuerno dotado de un poder místico que provoca daño físico.
secret-sword.descEN: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn deals physical damage to the target.
secret-sword.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

glaciate.descES: Ataque con aire helado que baja la Velocidad del objetivo.
glaciate.descEN: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Speed stats.
glaciate.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

bolt-strike.descES: Ataca envolviéndose de una gran carga eléctrica y embistiendo al objetivo con ella. Puede paralizar.
bolt-strike.descEN: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
bolt-strike.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

blue-flare.descES: Ataca con una bella pero potente llama azul que rodea al objetivo. Puede quemarlo.
blue-flare.descEN: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.
blue-flare.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

fiery-dance.descES: Envuelve en llamas y daña al objetivo. Puede aumentar el Ataque Especial de quien lo usa.
fiery-dance.descEN: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by dancing and flapping its wings. This may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
fiery-dance.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

freeze-shock.descES: El usuario carga un bloque de hielo con electricidad en el primer turno y ataca con él en el segundo. Puede paralizar.
freeze-shock.descEN: The turn after using this move, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
freeze-shock.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

ice-burn.descES: Ataca al objetivo en el segundo turno rodeándolo de un aire gélido. Puede causar quemaduras.
ice-burn.descEN: The turn after using this move, the user surrounds the target with an ultracold, freezing wind to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.
ice-burn.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. User charges for one turn before attacking.

snarl.descES: Chillido desagradable que baja el Ataque Especial del rival.
snarl.descEN: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
snarl.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

icicle-crash.descES: Lanza grandes carámbanos. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
icicle-crash.descEN: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
icicle-crash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

v-create.descES: Golpea con una V de llamas al objetivo. Baja la Defensa, la Defensa Especial y la Velocidad de quien lo usa.
v-create.descEN: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
v-create.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

fusion-flare.descES: Ataca con una llamarada gigantesca. Aumenta su potencia si es influenciada por una gran energía eléctrica.
fusion-flare.descEN: The user brings down a giant flame. This move's power is boosted when influenced by an enormous lightning bolt.
fusion-flare.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Bolt earlier this turn, this move has double power.

fusion-bolt.descES: Ataca con una enorme descarga eléctrica. Aumenta su potencia si es influenciada por una gigantesca llamarada.
fusion-bolt.descEN: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move's power is boosted when influenced by an enormous flame.
fusion-bolt.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fusion Flare earlier this turn, this move has double power.

flying-press.descES: El Pokémon que lo usa se lanza sobre su oponente. Este movimiento es de tipo Lucha y tipo Volador al mismo tiempo.
flying-press.descEN: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
flying-press.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the purposes of type effectiveness, this move is both Fighting- and Flying-type: its final effectiveness is determined by multiplying the effectiveness of each type against each of the target’s types. For all other purposes, this move is pure Fighting-type. If this move’s type is changed, its Fighting typing is overwritten, and its secondary type remains Flying. If the target has used Minimize since entering battle, this move has double power and will never miss.

mat-block.descES: El usuario usa un tatami para escudarse de los ataques enemigos. Protege también a los aliados. No funciona contra movimientos de estado.
mat-block.descEN: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.
mat-block.efectoMovEN: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves. Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.

belch.descES: El Pokémon causa daño a su oponente lanzándole un eructo. Para poder utilizar este movimiento tiene que llevar una baya y comérsela.
belch.descEN: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
belch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used if the user has eaten a berry since the beginning of the battle. After the user eats a berry, it may use this move any number of times until the end of the battle, even if it switches out. Eating a held berry, eating a berry via Bug Bite or Pluck, or being the target of a Flung berry will enable this move. Feeding a Pokémon a berry from the bag or using Natural Gift will not. If the trainer chooses this move when it cannot be used, the choice is rejected outright and the trainer must choose another move.

rototiller.descES: Labra la tierra haciendo que sea más fácil cultivarla y consigue que aumente el Ataque y el Ataque Especial de los Pokémon de tipo Planta.
rototiller.descEN: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.
rototiller.efectoMovEN: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

sticky-web.descES: Coloca una red pegajosa alrededor del equipo rival que baja la Velocidad de cualquier adversario que entre a combatir.
sticky-web.descEN: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.
sticky-web.efectoMovEN: Shoots a web over the opponents’ side of the field, which lowers the Speed of any opposing Pokémon that enters the field by one stage. Pokémon in the air, such as Flying-types and those with Levitate, are unaffected. Rapid Spin removes Sticky Web from the user’s side of the field; Defog removes it from both sides.

fell-stinger.descES: Si se derrota al objetivo utilizando este movimiento, aumenta muchísimo el Ataque del usuario.
fell-stinger.descEN: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.
fell-stinger.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.

phantom-force.descES: El usuario desaparece en el primer turno y ataca a su objetivo en el segundo. Permite acertar aunque el objetivo esté protegiéndose.
phantom-force.descEN: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
phantom-force.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

trick-or-treat.descES: Invita al objetivo a celebrar Halloween, lo que añade el tipo Fantasma a los tipos de este.
trick-or-treat.descEN: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
trick-or-treat.efectoMovEN: Adds Ghost to the target’s types.

noble-roar.descES: Intimida a su oponente con un rugido de guerra, lo que hace que disminuyan tanto su Ataque como su Ataque Especial.
noble-roar.descEN: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
noble-roar.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

ion-deluge.descES: El Pokémon disemina partículas con carga eléctrica que convierten los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico.
ion-deluge.descEN: The user disperses electrically charged particles, which changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
ion-deluge.efectoMovEN: Changes all Pokémon’s Normal moves to Electric moves for the rest of the turn.

parabolic-charge.descES: Inflige daño a todos los Pokémon a su alrededor. El usuario absorbe la mitad del daño producido para restaurar sus propios PS.
parabolic-charge.descEN: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.
parabolic-charge.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.

forests-curse.descES: El objetivo es presa de la maldición del bosque, por lo que pasa a ser un Pokémon de tipo Planta, además de conservar sus tipos habituales.
forests-curse.descEN: The user puts a forest curse on the target. This adds Grass type to the target's type.
forests-curse.efectoMovEN: Adds Grass to the target’s types.

petal-blizzard.descES: El usuario desata un intenso vendaval de pétalos que daña a los Pokémon a su alrededor.
petal-blizzard.descEN: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

freeze-dry.descES: Enfría súbitamente al objetivo e incluso puede congelarlo. Es supereficaz contra Pokémon de tipo Agua.
freeze-dry.descEN: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
freeze-dry.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. This move is super-effective against the Water type. The target’s other type will affect damage as usual. If this move’s type is changed, it remains super-effective against Water regardless of its type.

disarming-voice.descES: Obnubila a los oponentes con su fascinante voz y les provoca daños emocionales. Siempre acierta al objetivo.
disarming-voice.descEN: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
disarming-voice.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion.

parting-shot.descES: El usuario se cambia por otro Pokémon de su equipo, pero antes amedrenta a su oponente y hace que disminuyan su Ataque y Ataque Especial.
parting-shot.descEN: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
parting-shot.efectoMovEN: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage. Makes the user switch out.

topsy-turvy.descES: Invierte por completo los cambios en las características del objetivo.
topsy-turvy.descEN: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

draining-kiss.descES: El usuario absorbe PS del objetivo con un beso y restaura su propia energía en una cantidad igual o superior a la mitad del daño infligido.
draining-kiss.descEN: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
draining-kiss.efectoMovEN: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

crafty-shield.descES: Usa unos misteriosos poderes para protegerse a sí mismo y a sus aliados de movimientos de estado, pero no de otro tipo de ataques.
crafty-shield.descEN: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.
crafty-shield.efectoMovEN: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn. Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.

flower-shield.descES: Aumenta la Defensa de todos los Pokémon de tipo Planta que hay en el combate usando unos misteriosos poderes.
flower-shield.descEN: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
flower-shield.efectoMovEN: Raises the Defense of all Grass Pokémon in battle.

grassy-terrain.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Planta y los Pokémon que están en contacto con el suelo recuperan PS en cada turno.
grassy-terrain.descEN: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
grassy-terrain.efectoMovEN: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball.

misty-terrain.descES: Durante cinco turnos, los Pokémon que están en el suelo no sufren problemas de estado y se reduce a la mitad el daño de los movimientos de tipo Dragón.
misty-terrain.descEN: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
misty-terrain.efectoMovEN: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

electrify.descES: Si el objetivo queda electrificado antes de usar un movimiento, este será de tipo Eléctrico.
electrify.descEN: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
electrify.efectoMovEN: Changes the target’s move’s type to Electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.

play-rough.descES: El Pokémon que lo usa le hace cucamonas al objetivo y lo ataca. Puede disminuir el Ataque del objetivo.
play-rough.descEN: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
play-rough.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

fairy-wind.descES: El Pokémon que lo usa desata un vendaval feérico que arremete contra el objetivo.
fairy-wind.descEN: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

moonblast.descES: Invoca el poder de la luna para atacar al objetivo. Puede disminuir el Ataque Especial del objetivo.
moonblast.descEN: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moonblast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

boomburst.descES: Ataca a todos los Pokémon a su alrededor con una potentísima onda sonora.
boomburst.descEN: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

fairy-lock.descES: Consigue que ningún Pokémon pueda huir en el siguiente turno echando un cerrojo.
fairy-lock.descEN: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
fairy-lock.efectoMovEN: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.

kings-shield.descES: El usuario adopta una postura defensiva y se protege de cualquier daño. Reduce el Ataque de cualquier Pokémon con el que entre en contacto.
kings-shield.descEN: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
kings-shield.efectoMovEN: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact. Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

play-nice.descES: Se hace amigo de su oponente y consigue que a este se le quiten las ganas de combatir. Además, reduce su Ataque.
play-nice.descEN: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
play-nice.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

confide.descES: Hace que el objetivo pierda la concentración contándole un secreto. Disminuye el Ataque Especial del oponente.
confide.descEN: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
confide.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

diamond-storm.descES: Desata un devastador vendaval de diamantes para dañar a los oponentes. Puede aumentar mucho la Defensa del usuario.
diamond-storm.descEN: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply boost the user's Defense stat.
diamond-storm.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.

steam-eruption.descES: Envuelve al Pokémon oponente con vapor extremadamente caliente que puede llegar a quemarlo.
steam-eruption.descEN: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
