steam-eruption.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

hyperspace-hole.descES: El usuario aparece junto al rival usando un agujero dimensional y le asesta un golpe que movimientos como Protección o Detección no pueden evitar.
hyperspace-hole.descEN: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
hyperspace-hole.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

water-shuriken.descES: Golpea al oponente de dos a cinco veces con estrellas arrojadizas hechas de mucosidad. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
water-shuriken.descEN: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

mystical-fire.descES: El usuario lanza por la boca una singular llama a gran temperatura con la que ataca a su oponente y baja su Ataque Especial.
mystical-fire.descEN: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
mystical-fire.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

spiky-shield.descES: Protege al usuario de ataques, e inflige daño a quien se los lance si entra en contacto con él.
spiky-shield.descEN: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.
spiky-shield.efectoMovEN: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.

aromatic-mist.descES: Consigue aumentar la Defensa Especial de un Pokémon de su equipo con una fragancia misteriosa.
aromatic-mist.descEN: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
aromatic-mist.efectoMovEN: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.

eerie-impulse.descES: El usuario irradia unas raras ondas que, al alcanzar a un oponente, hacen que disminuya mucho su Ataque Especial.
eerie-impulse.descEN: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
eerie-impulse.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.

venom-drench.descES: Impregna a su objetivo con un líquido venenoso que disminuye el Ataque, el Ataque Especial y la Velocidad. Solo afecta a Pokémon ya envenenados.
venom-drench.descEN: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
venom-drench.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

powder.descES: Esparce un polvo sobre el objetivo. Si este usa un movimiento de tipo Fuego en el mismo turno, el polvo explota y le inflige daño.
powder.descEN: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.
powder.efectoMovEN: Explodes if the target uses a Fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.

geomancy.descES: Concentra energía durante el primer turno, de forma que su Velocidad, Ataque Especial y Defensa Especial aumenten mucho en el segundo.
geomancy.descEN: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
geomancy.efectoMovEN: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.

magnetic-flux.descES: Manipula el campo magnético y logra aumentar la Defensa y la Defensa Especial de los Pokémon aliados que cuenten con las habilidades Más y Menos.
magnetic-flux.descEN: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.
magnetic-flux.efectoMovEN: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

happy-hour.descES: Al usar este movimiento se consigue duplicar la recompensa recibida tras el combate.
happy-hour.descEN: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
happy-hour.efectoMovEN: Doubles prize money. Stacks with a held item. Only works once per battle.

electric-terrain.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico y los Pokémon que están en contacto con el suelo no pueden quedarse dormidos.
electric-terrain.descEN: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
electric-terrain.efectoMovEN: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

dazzling-gleam.descES: Inflige daño a los oponentes con una potente luz.
dazzling-gleam.descEN: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

celebrate.descES: El Pokémon te felicita en un día muy especial para ti.
celebrate.descEN: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

hold-hands.descES: El Pokémon le da la mano a un aliado y ambos se sienten muy felices.
hold-hands.descEN: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

baby-doll-eyes.descES: Lanza una mirada al objetivo con ojos acaramelados, con lo que logra que su Ataque se reduzca. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
baby-doll-eyes.descEN: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
baby-doll-eyes.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

nuzzle.descES: Quien lo usa frota sus mofletes cargados de electricidad contra el objetivo y consigue paralizarlo.
nuzzle.descEN: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
nuzzle.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

hold-back.descES: El usuario se contiene a la hora de atacar y deja al objetivo con al menos 1 PS.
hold-back.descEN: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
hold-back.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

infestation.descES: Hostiga al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos e impide que pueda huir mientras tanto.
infestation.descEN: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
infestation.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

power-up-punch.descES: Cada vez que golpea a un oponente se endurecen sus puños. Si acierta al objetivo, el Ataque del usuario aumenta.
power-up-punch.descEN: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
power-up-punch.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

oblivion-wing.descES: El usuario absorbe energía del objetivo y aumenta sus PS en una cantidad igual o superior a la mitad del daño infligido.
oblivion-wing.descEN: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
oblivion-wing.efectoMovEN: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

thousand-arrows.descES: Acierta incluso a Pokémon que estén en el aire y los hace caer al suelo.
thousand-arrows.descEN: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
thousand-arrows.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Grounds the target until it leaves battle. Ignores levitation effects and the immunity of Flying-type Pokémon.

thousand-waves.descES: El usuario genera ondas sísmicas que se propagan por el suelo y sacuden a los oponentes. Los Pokémon alcanzados no podrán huir del combate.
thousand-waves.descEN: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.
thousand-waves.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

lands-wrath.descES: Acumula energía de la corteza terrestre y la concentra contra los oponentes, dañándolos.
lands-wrath.descEN: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.

light-of-ruin.descES: El usuario emplea el poder de la Flor Eterna para lanzar un potente rayo de luz, pero sufre bastante daño al hacerlo.
light-of-ruin.descEN: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.
light-of-ruin.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

origin-pulse.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una infinidad de rayos de luz azulada.
origin-pulse.descEN: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

precipice-blades.descES: Hace que el poder latente de la tierra se manifieste en forma de hojas afiladas y ataca al objetivo con ellas.
precipice-blades.descEN: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

dragon-ascent.descES: El usuario se precipita desde el cielo a una velocidad de vértigo para atacar al objetivo, pero hace que bajen la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del usuario.
dragon-ascent.descEN: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
dragon-ascent.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

hyperspace-fury.descES: Ataca al objetivo con una ráfaga de golpes que pasan por alto los efectos de movimientos como Protección o Detección. Baja la Defensa del usuario.
hyperspace-fury.descEN: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user's Defense stat.
hyperspace-fury.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

breakneck-blitz--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para coger carrerilla y arremeter contra el objetivo con gran fuerza. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
breakneck-blitz--physical.descEN: The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

all-out-pummeling--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para lanzar una sarta de golpes demoledores contra el objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
all-out-pummeling--physical.descEN: The user rams an energy orb created by its Z-Power into the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

supersonic-skystrike--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para volar muy alto y abalanzarse en picado sobre el objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
supersonic-skystrike--physical.descEN: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

acid-downpour--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para crear una ciénaga venenosa en la que sumerge al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
acid-downpour--physical.descEN: The user creates a poisonous swamp using its Z-Power and sinks the target into it at full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

tectonic-rage--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para abrir una profunda grieta en el suelo que se traga al oponente. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
tectonic-rage--physical.descEN: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

continental-crush--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para crear una montaña rocosa con la que aplasta al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
continental-crush--physical.descEN: The user summons a huge rock mountain using its Z-Power and drops it onto the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

savage-spin-out--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para encerrar a su oponente en un capullo contra el que arremete con fuerza. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
savage-spin-out--physical.descEN: The user binds the target with full force with threads of silk that the user spits using its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

never-ending-nightmare--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para invocar a unos espectros encolerizados que apresan al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
never-ending-nightmare--physical.descEN: Deep-seated grudges summoned by the user’s Z-Power trap the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

corkscrew-crash--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para girar a toda velocidad y perforar al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
corkscrew-crash--physical.descEN: The user spins very fast and rams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

inferno-overdrive--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para lanzar una enorme llamarada con la que calcina a su objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
inferno-overdrive--physical.descEN: The user breathes a stream of intense fire toward the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies depending on the original move.

hydro-vortex--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para crear un potente torbellino de agua que engulle al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
hydro-vortex--physical.descEN: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

bloom-doom--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para concentrar la energía de la vegetación que lo rodea y atacar al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
bloom-doom--physical.descEN: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

gigavolt-havoc--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para generar una fuerte descarga eléctrica con la que electrocuta al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
gigavolt-havoc--physical.descEN: The user hits the target with a powerful electric current collected by its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

shattered-psyche--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para manipular la mente del objetivo, infligiéndole un daño ingente. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
shattered-psyche--physical.descEN: The user controls the target with its Z-Power and hurts the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

subzero-slammer--physical.descES: Emplea el Poder Z para lanzar un rayo de hielo que baja la temperatura de golpe y congela al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
subzero-slammer--physical.descEN: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

devastating-drake--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para materializar su aura y golpear al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
devastating-drake--physical.descEN: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

black-hole-eclipse--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para generar un agujero negro que absorbe al objetivo. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
black-hole-eclipse--physical.descEN: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it. The power varies, depending on the original move.

twinkle-tackle--physical.descES: El usuario emplea el Poder Z para crear una dimensión fascinante que deja al rival a su merced. Su potencia depende de la del movimiento original.
twinkle-tackle--physical.descEN: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

catastropika.descES: Pikachu emplea el Poder Z para acumular una gran cantidad de electricidad en su cuerpo y arremeter contra el objetivo.
catastropika.descEN: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.

shore-up.descES: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del usuario. Durante las tormentas de arena, restaura aún más PS.
shore-up.descEN: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in a sandstorm.
shore-up.efectoMovEN: Heals the user for ½ its max HP. During a Sandstorm, the healing is increased to ⅔.

first-impression.descES: Movimiento de gran potencia que solo puede usarse en el turno en que el usuario sale al combate.
first-impression.descEN: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
first-impression.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

baneful-bunker.descES: Protege de los ataques y, al mismo tiempo, envenena al Pokémon que use un movimiento de contacto contra el usuario.
baneful-bunker.descEN: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
baneful-bunker.efectoMovEN: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn. If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned. This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.

spirit-shackle.descES: Ataca al oponente y, al mismo tiempo, fija su sombra al terreno para impedir su huida.
spirit-shackle.descEN: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.
spirit-shackle.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

darkest-lariat.descES: Gira sobre sí mismo y golpea al oponente con ambos brazos. Ignora los cambios en las características del objetivo.
darkest-lariat.descEN: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
darkest-lariat.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

sparkling-aria.descES: Libera burbujas al cantar. Este movimiento cura las quemaduras de los Pokémon que reciban daño.
sparkling-aria.descEN: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.
sparkling-aria.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed.

ice-hammer.descES: Un terrible puño golpea al contrincante, pero la Velocidad del usuario se ve reducida.
ice-hammer.descEN: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
ice-hammer.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

floral-healing.descES: Restaura la mitad de los PS máximos del objetivo. Es más efectivo cuando se usa en conjunción con Campo de Hierba.
floral-healing.descEN: The user restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP. More HP is restored when the ground is Grassy Terrain.
floral-healing.efectoMovEN: Heals the target for ½ its max HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.

high-horsepower.descES: Asesta un golpe devastador usando todo su cuerpo.
high-horsepower.descEN: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

strength-sap.descES: Restaura una cantidad de PS equivalente al valor de Ataque del rival, que además verá reducida esta característica.
strength-sap.descEN: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.
strength-sap.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect. If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail. In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.

solar-blade.descES: El usuario dedica un turno a absorber energía lumínica y concentrarla en forma de cuchilla con la que ataca al rival en el siguiente turno.
solar-blade.descEN: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.
solar-blade.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

leafage.descEN: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

spotlight.descES: Convierte a uno de los Pokémon que están combatiendo en el foco de atención, de modo que todos los ataques se dirijan hacia él.
spotlight.descEN: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
spotlight.efectoMovEN: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.

toxic-thread.descES: Ataca al oponente con hilillos venenosos que reducen su Velocidad y lo envenenan.
toxic-thread.descEN: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
toxic-thread.efectoMovEN: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.

laser-focus.descES: El usuario se concentra para que el siguiente ataque propine un golpe crítico.
laser-focus.descEN: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
laser-focus.efectoMovEN: The user’s next move will result in a critical hit.

gear-up.descES: Cambia de marcha y logra aumentar el Ataque y el Ataque Especial de los Pokémon aliados que cuenten con las habilidades Más y Menos.
gear-up.descEN: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
gear-up.efectoMovEN: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

throat-chop.descES: Inflige al rival un dolor tan abrumador que le impide utilizar durante dos turnos ataques que se sirven del sonido.
throat-chop.descEN: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
throat-chop.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

pollen-puff.descES: Ataca al oponente con una bola explosiva. Si esta alcanza a un aliado, le hará recuperar PS.
pollen-puff.descEN: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
pollen-puff.efectoMovEN: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.

anchor-shot.descES: Ataca lanzando un ancla al oponente, que queda atrapado y no puede huir.
anchor-shot.descEN: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
anchor-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

psychic-terrain.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Psíquico y los Pokémon que están en el suelo quedan protegidos contra movimientos con prioridad.
psychic-terrain.descEN: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
psychic-terrain.efectoMovEN: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

lunge.descES: Ataca al oponente abalanzándose sobre él con todas sus fuerzas y reduce su Ataque.
lunge.descEN: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
lunge.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

fire-lash.descES: Golpea al oponente con un látigo incandescente y reduce su Defensa.
fire-lash.descEN: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
fire-lash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

power-trip.descES: Ataca al oponente presumiendo de su fuerza. Cuanto más hayan subido las características del usuario, mayor será el daño.
power-trip.descEN: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
power-trip.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

burn-up.descES: Utiliza hasta el último resquicio de llamas de su cuerpo para infligir un grave daño al oponente. Tras el ataque, el usuario deja de ser de tipo Fuego.
burn-up.descEN: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
burn-up.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.

speed-swap.descES: Intercambia su Velocidad por la del oponente.
speed-swap.descEN: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
speed-swap.efectoMovEN: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.

smart-strike.descES: El usuario ensarta al adversario con su afilada cornamenta. Este movimiento acierta siempre.
smart-strike.descEN: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
smart-strike.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

purify.descES: Cura los problemas de estado del Pokémon rival y a cambio recupera PS propios.
purify.descEN: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.
purify.efectoMovEN: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP. If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.

revelation-dance.descES: Ataque que consiste en un baile muy enérgico. El tipo de este ataque se corresponde con el del Pokémon que lo ejecuta.
revelation-dance.descEN: The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.
revelation-dance.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless.

core-enforcer.descES: Inflige daño al rival, y si este ya ha hecho uso de algún movimiento, pierde su habilidad.
core-enforcer.descEN: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
core-enforcer.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.

trop-kick.descES: Lanza una patada con la fuerza del trópico que golpea al rival y reduce su Ataque.
trop-kick.descEN: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
trop-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

instruct.descES: Fuerza al objetivo a repetir inmediatamente su último movimiento.
instruct.descEN: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.
instruct.efectoMovEN: The target immediately uses its most recently-used move. This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP. This effect works for disabled moves and ignores Torment.

beak-blast.descES: Primero aumenta la temperatura de su pico y luego ejecuta un ataque. Quema al rival si este le propina un ataque físico mientras está calentando el pico.
beak-blast.descEN: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
beak-blast.efectoMovEN: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal. Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned. The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.

clanging-scales.descES: Frota todas las escamas de su cuerpo para crear un fuerte sonido con el que ataca. Cuando el ataque termina, su Defensa se ve reducida.
clanging-scales.descEN: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.
clanging-scales.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.

dragon-hammer.descES: Usa el cuerpo como un martillo para abalanzarse sobre su rival y causarle daño.
dragon-hammer.descEN: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

brutal-swing.descES: Hace pivotar su cuerpo para causar daño a su alrededor.
brutal-swing.descEN: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

aurora-veil.descES: Reduce el daño de los ataques físicos y especiales que ejecuta el rival durante cinco turnos. Solo puede usarse cuando está granizando.
aurora-veil.descEN: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
aurora-veil.efectoMovEN: Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns. If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail. Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½. (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)

sinister-arrow-raid.descES: Decidueye usa el Poder Z para proyectar multitud de flechas potentísimas que atraviesan a su oponente.
sinister-arrow-raid.descEN: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.

malicious-moonsault.descES: Incineroar refuerza sus músculos con el Poder Z para golpear con todas sus fuerzas a su oponente.
malicious-moonsault.descEN: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.

oceanic-operetta.descES: Primarina invoca ingentes cantidades de agua con el Poder Z para atacar con gran potencia a su rival.
oceanic-operetta.descEN: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force.

guardian-of-alola.descES: Los Pokémon Dios Nativo canalizan la energía de Alola gracias al Poder Z y atacan con gran fuerza a sus rivales. Reducen un gran porcentaje de sus PS.
guardian-of-alola.descEN: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola’s energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target’s HP greatly.
guardian-of-alola.efectoMovEN: Inflicts direct damage equal to ¾ of the target’s remaining HP.

soul-stealing-7-star-strike.descES: Cuando Marshadow obtiene el Poder Z, lanza una potente y continua oleada de puñetazos y patadas con la que castiga a su rival.
soul-stealing-7-star-strike.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.

stoked-sparksurfer.descES: Cuando un Raichu de Alola obtiene el Poder Z, lanza un potente ataque contra su enemigo y lo deja paralizado.
stoked-sparksurfer.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.
stoked-sparksurfer.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

pulverizing-pancake.descES: Gracias al Poder Z, Snorlax puede mover su enorme cuerpo con gran agilidad y determinación, cargando sobre el oponente con todas sus fuerzas.
pulverizing-pancake.descEN: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.

extreme-evoboost.descES: Cuando Eevee obtiene el Poder Z, toma prestada la energía de sus amigos evolucionados para potenciar enormemente sus características.
extreme-evoboost.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.
extreme-evoboost.efectoMovEN: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages each.

genesis-supernova.descES: Mew usa el Poder Z para realizar un potente ataque contra su adversario y crear un Campo Psíquico sobre el terreno.
genesis-supernova.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.
genesis-supernova.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

shell-trap.descES: El caparazón del Pokémon se convierte en una trampa. Si le alcanza un ataque físico, la trampa estalla y los oponentes sufren daño.
shell-trap.descEN: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.
shell-trap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.

fleur-cannon.descES: El usuario emite un potente rayo, pero su Ataque Especial se reduce mucho.
fleur-cannon.descEN: The user unleashes a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
fleur-cannon.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

psychic-fangs.descES: Ataca a sus rivales con poderes psíquicos que además destruyen barreras como Pantalla de Luz y Reflejo.
psychic-fangs.descEN: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
psychic-fangs.efectoMovEN: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

stomping-tantrum.descES: Usa la frustración como revulsivo para atacar. La potencia de Pataleta se duplica si el usuario ha fallado el último movimiento usado.
stomping-tantrum.descEN: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
stomping-tantrum.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

shadow-bone.descES: Ataca al oponente golpeándole con un hueso poseído por un espíritu. Puede reducir la Defensa del objetivo.
shadow-bone.descEN: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
shadow-bone.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

accelerock.descES: El usuario se lanza contra el objetivo a gran velocidad. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta.
accelerock.descEN: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

liquidation.descES: Ataca golpeando gracias a la fuerza del agua. También puede reducir la Defensa del objetivo.
liquidation.descEN: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
liquidation.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

prismatic-laser.descES: El usuario utiliza un prisma para emitir un rayo de gran potencia, pero no puede moverse en el turno siguiente.
prismatic-laser.descEN: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
prismatic-laser.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

spectral-thief.descES: El usuario se esconde en la sombra del objetivo y lo ataca tras robarle las mejoras en sus características.
spectral-thief.descEN: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
spectral-thief.efectoMovEN: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage. Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target. Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.

sunsteel-strike.descES: Ataca al objetivo con la potencia de un meteoro, ignorando su habilidad.
sunsteel-strike.descEN: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
sunsteel-strike.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

moongeist-beam.descES: Ataca con un rayo misterioso que ignora la habilidad del objetivo.
moongeist-beam.descEN: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
moongeist-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

tearful-look.descES: Mira al objetivo con ojos llorosos para hacerle perder su espíritu combativo y reduce su Ataque y Ataque Especial.
tearful-look.descEN: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
tearful-look.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

zing-zap.descES: Se lanza contra el objetivo y le suelta una potente descarga eléctrica que puede hacer que se amedrente.
zing-zap.descEN: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
zing-zap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

natures-madness.descES: Golpea al objetivo con la furia de la naturaleza y reduce sus PS a la mitad.
natures-madness.descEN: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
natures-madness.efectoMovEN: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

multi-attack.descES: El Pokémon se rodea de una potente energía con la que golpea al rival. El tipo del movimiento depende del disco que lleva el usuario.
multi-attack.descEN: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.
multi-attack.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

10-000-000-volt-thunderbolt.descES: Los Pikachu con gorra acumulan una carga eléctrica descomunal gracias al Poder Z y la lanzan contra el objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
10-000-000-volt-thunderbolt.descEN: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.

mind-blown.descES: El usuario hace explotar su cabeza para atacar a todos los Pokémon que se hallan a su alrededor, aunque también se hiere a sí mismo.
mind-blown.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
mind-blown.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

plasma-fists.descES: El usuario ataca con puños cargados de electricidad. Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.
plasma-fists.descEN: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
plasma-fists.efectoMovEN: After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize.

photon-geyser.descES: El usuario ataca con una gran columna de luz. Compara sus valores de Ataque y Ataque Especial para infligir daño con el más alto de los dos.
photon-geyser.descEN: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

light-that-burns-the-sky.descES: Necrozma escoge la característica que tenga el valor más alto entre el Ataque y el Ataque Especial para infligir daño, ignorando la habilidad del objetivo.
light-that-burns-the-sky.descEN: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage— whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move ignores the target’s Ability.
light-that-burns-the-sky.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage using either Attack or Special Attack stat, whichever is higher. Determining which stat is used takes into account stat changes but not held items or abilities.

searing-sunraze-smash.descES: Solgaleo ataca con toda su fuerza tras imbuirse del Poder Z. Este movimiento ignora la habilidad del objetivo.
searing-sunraze-smash.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability.
searing-sunraze-smash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

menacing-moonraze-maelstrom.descES: Lunala ataca con toda su fuerza tras imbuirse del Poder Z. Este movimiento ignora la habilidad del objetivo.
menacing-moonraze-maelstrom.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability.
menacing-moonraze-maelstrom.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

lets-snuggle-forever.descES: Mimikyu ataca con toda su fuerza tras imbuirse del Poder Z y asesta una lluvia de golpes.
lets-snuggle-forever.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

splintered-stormshards.descES: Lycanroc ataca con toda su fuerza tras imbuirse del Poder Z y neutraliza el campo que esté activo.
splintered-stormshards.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.
splintered-stormshards.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield.

clangorous-soulblaze.descES: Kommo-o ataca con toda su fuerza al objetivo tras imbuirse del Poder Z. Además, potencia sus propias características.
clangorous-soulblaze.descEN: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.
clangorous-soulblaze.efectoMovEN: Inflicts sound-based damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user’s stats are not raised if the move fails to damage any opposing Pokémon.

zippy-zap.descES: Ataque eléctrico a la velocidad del rayo. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta y propina golpes críticos.
zippy-zap.descEN: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.

splishy-splash.descES: Golpea al adversario con una ola gigante electrificada, que también puede paralizarlo.
splishy-splash.descEN: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

floaty-fall.descES: El usuario se suspende en el aire para, a continuación, abalanzarse súbitamente sobre el rival. Puede hacer retroceder al objetivo.
floaty-fall.descEN: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This may also make the target flinch.

pika-papow.descES: Lanza una descarga eléctrica infalible que resulta más potente cuanto mayor es el cariño que siente Pikachu hacia su Entrenador.
pika-papow.descEN: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.

bouncy-bubble.descES: Ataca lanzando proyectiles de agua y recupera una cantidad de PS equivalente a la mitad del daño causado.
bouncy-bubble.descEN: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by half the damage taken by the target.

buzzy-buzz.descES: Lanza una potente descarga eléctrica sobre el rival y lo deja paralizado.
buzzy-buzz.descEN: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

sizzly-slide.descES: Tras envolver su cuerpo en llamas, el usuario arrolla con fuerza al rival y le provoca quemaduras.
sizzly-slide.descEN: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also leaves the target with a burn.

glitzy-glow.descES: Envuelve al rival con ondas psíquicas y alza un extraño muro que debilita los ataques especiales del adversario.
glitzy-glow.descEN: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s special moves.

baddy-bad.descES: Lanza un ataque haciendo gala de su faceta más umbría y alza un extraño muro que mitiga los ataques físicos del adversario.
baddy-bad.descEN: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s physical moves.

sappy-seed.descES: Hace brotar un tallo gigante que bombardea al rival con unas semillas que le drenan PS en cada turno.
sappy-seed.descEN: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. The seeds drain the target’s HP every turn.

freezy-frost.descES: Ataca al rival con negros cristales de niebla congelada. Revierte los cambios en las características de todos los Pokémon presentes.
freezy-frost.descEN: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

sparkly-swirl.descES: Ataca al rival envolviéndolo en un remolino de aroma asfixiante. Cura a los aliados de cualquier problema de estado.
sparkly-swirl.descEN: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user’s party.

veevee-volley.descES: Un placaje infalible que resulta más potente cuanto mayor es el cariño que siente Eevee hacia su Entrenador.
veevee-volley.descEN: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.

double-iron-bash.descES: Usando la tuerca del pecho como eje, gira sobre sí mismo y golpea con los brazos dos veces seguidas. Puede amedrentar al rival.
double-iron-bash.descEN: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
double-iron-bash.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

max-guard.descES: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
max-guard.descEN: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
max-guard.efectoMovEN: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

dynamax-cannon.descES: El usuario ataca emitiendo un rayo desde su núcleo. El daño infligido se duplica si el objetivo ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax.
dynamax-cannon.descEN: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.
dynamax-cannon.efectoMovEN: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

snipe-shot.descES: Permite atacar al objetivo seleccionado ignorando las habilidades o movimientos que permiten a un rival centrar la atención sobre sí.
snipe-shot.descEN: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
snipe-shot.efectoMovEN: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

jaw-lock.descES: Impide que tanto el atacante como el defensor puedan ser intercambiados hasta que uno de ellos se debilite o abandone el terreno de combate.
jaw-lock.descEN: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.
jaw-lock.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage, then prevents you and the target from switching out. The user or target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. If they do, the effect ends.

stuff-cheeks.descES: El usuario ingiere la baya que lleva equipada para aumentar mucho su Defensa.
stuff-cheeks.descEN: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.
stuff-cheeks.efectoMovEN: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.

no-retreat.descES: El usuario aumenta todas sus características, pero ya no puede huir ni ser cambiado por otro.
no-retreat.descEN: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
no-retreat.efectoMovEN: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.

tar-shot.descES: Cubre al objetivo de un alquitrán pegajoso que reduce su Velocidad y lo vuelve débil contra el fuego.
tar-shot.descEN: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
tar-shot.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

magic-powder.descES: Cubre al objetivo con unos polvos mágicos que le hacen adquirir el tipo Psíquico.
magic-powder.descEN: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.
magic-powder.efectoMovEN: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is Arceus, Silvally, or is already only a Psychic type.

dragon-darts.descES: El usuario ataca propulsando a ambos Dreepy. En caso de haber dos adversarios, cada Dreepy golpea a su propio objetivo por separado.
dragon-darts.descEN: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
dragon-darts.efectoMovEN: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

teatime.descES: El usuario invita a tomar el té a todos los presentes en el terreno de combate, lo que hace que ingieran las bayas que lleven equipadas.
teatime.descEN: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
teatime.efectoMovEN: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.

octolock.descES: Retiene al objetivo para impedir su huida, a la vez que reduce su Defensa y Defensa Especial cada turno.
octolock.descEN: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
octolock.efectoMovEN: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.

bolt-beak.descES: El usuario ensarta al objetivo con su pico cargado de electricidad. Si ataca en primer lugar, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
bolt-beak.descEN: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
bolt-beak.efectoMovEN: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

fishious-rend.descES: El usuario agarra al objetivo con sus duras branquias. En caso de atacar antes que este último, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
fishious-rend.descEN: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
fishious-rend.efectoMovEN: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

court-change.descES: Extraño poder que intercambia los efectos en el terreno de combate de ambos bandos.
court-change.descEN: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
court-change.efectoMovEN: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

max-flare.descES: Ataque de tipo Fuego ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos.
max-flare.descEN: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.
max-flare.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

max-flutterby.descES: Ataque de tipo Bicho ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce el Ataque Especial del objetivo.
max-flutterby.descEN: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
max-flutterby.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, lower the Special Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

max-lightning.descES: Ataque de tipo Eléctrico ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo eléctrico durante cinco turnos.
max-lightning.descEN: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.
max-lightning.efectoMovEN: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

max-strike.descES: Ataque de tipo Normal ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce la Velocidad del objetivo.
max-strike.descEN: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Speed stat.
max-strike.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, lower the Speed of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

max-knuckle.descES: Ataque de tipo Lucha ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Aumenta el Ataque de tu bando.
max-knuckle.descEN: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.
max-knuckle.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, raise the Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

max-phantasm.descES: Ataque de tipo Fantasma ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce la Defensa de los rivales.
max-phantasm.descEN: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.
max-phantasm.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, lower the Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

max-hailstorm.descES: Ataque de tipo Hielo ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea una tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos.
max-hailstorm.descEN: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.
max-hailstorm.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

max-ooze.descES: Ataque de tipo Veneno ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Aumenta el Ataque Especial de tu bando.
max-ooze.descEN: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.
max-ooze.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, raise the Special Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

max-geyser.descES: Ataque de tipo Agua ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Desata un aguacero que dura cinco turnos.
max-geyser.descEN: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.
max-geyser.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

max-airstream.descES: Ataque de tipo Volador ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Aumenta la Velocidad de tu bando.
max-airstream.descEN: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.
max-airstream.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, raise the Speed of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

max-starfall.descES: Ataque de tipo Hada ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo de niebla durante cinco turnos.
max-starfall.descEN: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.
max-starfall.efectoMovEN: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

max-wyrmwind.descES: Ataque de tipo Dragón ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce el Ataque del objetivo.
max-wyrmwind.descEN: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.
max-wyrmwind.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, lower the Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

max-mindstorm.descES: Ataque de tipo Psíquico ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo psíquico durante cinco turnos.
max-mindstorm.descEN: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.
max-mindstorm.efectoMovEN: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

max-rockfall.descES: Ataque de tipo Roca ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Levanta una tormenta de arena que dura cinco turnos.
max-rockfall.descEN: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.
max-rockfall.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

max-quake.descES: Ataque de tipo Tierra ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Aumenta la Defensa Especial de tu bando.
max-quake.descEN: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.
max-quake.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, raise the Special Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

max-darkness.descES: Ataque de tipo Siniestro ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Reduce la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
max-darkness.descEN: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
max-darkness.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, lower the Special Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.

max-overgrowth.descES: Ataque de tipo Planta ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo de hierba durante cinco turnos.
max-overgrowth.descEN: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.
max-overgrowth.efectoMovEN: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball.

max-steelspike.descES: Ataque de tipo Acero ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Aumenta la Defensa de tu bando.
max-steelspike.descEN: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
max-steelspike.efectoMovEN: If this move hits, raise the Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.

clangorous-soul.descES: Utiliza parte de los PS propios para subir sus características.
clangorous-soul.descEN: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
clangorous-soul.efectoMovEN: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.

body-press.descES: El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.
body-press.descEN: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
body-press.efectoMovEN: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

decorate.descES: Aumenta mucho el Ataque y el Ataque Especial del objetivo al decorarlo.
decorate.descEN: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
decorate.efectoMovEN: Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

drum-beating.descES: El usuario controla un tocón mediante la percusión y al atacar reduce la Velocidad del objetivo.
drum-beating.descEN: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
drum-beating.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

snap-trap.descES: Cepo que atrapa al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos y le causa daño mientras se encuentra preso.
snap-trap.descEN: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
snap-trap.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

pyro-ball.descES: El usuario prende una pequeña piedra para crear una bola de fuego con la que ataca al rival. Puede causar quemaduras.
pyro-ball.descEN: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
pyro-ball.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

behemoth-blade.descES: El usuario se convierte en una espada gigante para rebanar al objetivo. Si este ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax, se duplica el daño infligido.
behemoth-blade.descEN: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
behemoth-blade.efectoMovEN: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

behemoth-bash.descES: El usuario se convierte en un escudo gigante para golpear al objetivo. Si este ha alcanzado el estado Dinamax, se duplica el daño infligido.
behemoth-bash.descEN: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
behemoth-bash.efectoMovEN: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

aura-wheel.descES: La energía que acumula en las mejillas le sirve para atacar y aumentar su Velocidad. Este movimiento cambia de tipo según la forma que adopte Morpeko.
aura-wheel.descEN: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
aura-wheel.efectoMovEN: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. Fails unless the user is Hangry Mode or Full Belly Mode Morpeko.

breaking-swipe.descES: El usuario sacude violentamente su enorme cola para golpear a todos los rivales y reducir su Ataque a la par.
breaking-swipe.descEN: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
breaking-swipe.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

branch-poke.descES: Ataca pinchando al objetivo con una rama afilada.
branch-poke.descEN: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

overdrive.descES: El usuario rasguea la guitarra o el bajo para generar enormes vibraciones de intensa reverberación con las que ataca al objetivo.
overdrive.descEN: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

apple-acid.descES: Ataca al objetivo con el fluido corrosivo que desprende una manzana ácida, lo que también disminuye la Defensa Especial de este.
apple-acid.descEN: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
apple-acid.efectoMovEN: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.

grav-apple.descES: El usuario ataca haciendo caer una manzana desde gran altura. Disminuye la Defensa del objetivo.
grav-apple.descEN: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
grav-apple.efectoMovEN: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.

spirit-break.descES: El usuario ataca al objetivo con tal ímpetu que acaba minando su moral y, en consecuencia, reduce su Ataque Especial.
spirit-break.descEN: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
spirit-break.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

strange-steam.descES: Desprende un humo con el que ataca al objetivo, que puede acabar confundido.
strange-steam.descEN: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
strange-steam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

life-dew.descES: Vierte un agua misteriosa y balsámica que restaura tanto sus propios PS como los de aquellos aliados presentes en el terreno de combate.
life-dew.descEN: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
life-dew.efectoMovEN: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

obstruct.descES: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente. Reduce mucho la Defensa de quien ejecute un movimiento de contacto contra el usuario.
obstruct.descEN: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.
obstruct.efectoMovEN: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages.

false-surrender.descES: El usuario finge hacer una reverencia y aprovecha la ocasión para ensartar al objetivo con su cabello alborotado. Siempre acierta.
false-surrender.descEN: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
false-surrender.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

meteor-assault.descES: El usuario agita violentamente su grueso puerro para atacar, pero el mareo que le provocan las sacudidas le impide moverse en el turno siguiente.
meteor-assault.descEN: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
meteor-assault.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

eternabeam.descES: Este es el mayor ataque de Eternatus una vez adquirida su forma original. No puede moverse en el turno siguiente.
eternabeam.descEN: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
eternabeam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

steel-beam.descES: Utiliza el acero de su cuerpo para disparar un potente rayo. También hiere al agresor.
steel-beam.descEN: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
steel-beam.efectoMovEN: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

expanding-force.descES: El usuario ataca al objetivo con sus poderes psíquicos. Cuando se usa en conjunción con un campo psíquico, aumenta su potencia e inflige daño a todos los rivales.
expanding-force.descEN: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
expanding-force.efectoMovEN: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.

steel-roller.descES: El usuario lanza su ataque y destruye el campo activo en el terreno de combate, y falla si no hay ninguno en ese momento.
steel-roller.descEN: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
steel-roller.efectoMovEN: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.

scale-shot.descES: Lanza escamas al objetivo de dos a cinco veces seguidas. Aumenta la Velocidad del usuario, pero reduce su Defensa.
scale-shot.descEN: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
scale-shot.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

meteor-beam.descES: El usuario dedica el primer turno a aumentar su Ataque Especial acumulando energía cósmica y lanza su ofensiva contra el objetivo en el segundo.
meteor-beam.descEN: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
meteor-beam.efectoMovEN: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.

shell-side-arm.descES: El usuario lanza un ataque físico o especial en función de cuál inflija más daño. Puede envenenar al objetivo.
shell-side-arm.descEN: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.
shell-side-arm.efectoMovEN: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target. If the damage is tied, it is randomly chosen. This calculation ignores any modifiers other than stat stages.

misty-explosion.descES: El usuario ataca a todos a su alrededor, pero se debilita de inmediato. La potencia del movimiento aumenta si el terreno está cubierto por un campo de niebla.
misty-explosion.descEN: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
misty-explosion.efectoMovEN: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp.

grassy-glide.descES: Ataca al objetivo deslizándose sobre el terreno de combate. Este movimiento tiene prioridad alta cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo de hierba.
grassy-glide.descEN: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
grassy-glide.efectoMovEN: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.

rising-voltage.descES: Ataca con una descarga eléctrica que surge del terreno de combate. La potencia del movimiento se duplica si el rival se ve afectado por un campo eléctrico.
rising-voltage.descEN: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
rising-voltage.efectoMovEN: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.

terrain-pulse.descES: El usuario ataca aprovechando la energía del campo activo, que determina tanto el tipo como la potencia del movimiento.
terrain-pulse.descEN: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
terrain-pulse.efectoMovEN: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.

skitter-smack.descES: Ataca al objetivo por la espalda de forma subrepticia y además reduce su Ataque Especial.
skitter-smack.descEN: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
skitter-smack.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

burning-jealousy.descES: Ataca al objetivo con la energía generada por la envidia y causa quemaduras a los Pokémon cuyas características hayan aumentado en ese turno.
burning-jealousy.descEN: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
burning-jealousy.efectoMovEN: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.

lash-out.descES: Ataca al rival presa de la rabia. Si el usuario ha sufrido una reducción de características en ese turno, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.
lash-out.descEN: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
lash-out.efectoMovEN: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.

poltergeist.descES: El usuario ataca utilizando el objeto que lleva el rival. Si no tiene ninguno equipado, el movimiento falla.
poltergeist.descEN: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
poltergeist.efectoMovEN: Fails if the target has no held item.

corrosive-gas.descES: El usuario libera un gas cáustico que envuelve a todos los que se encuentren alrededor y derrite por completo los objetos que lleven equipados.
corrosive-gas.descEN: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
corrosive-gas.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

coaching.descES: El usuario imparte indicaciones precisas a sus aliados, que ven aumentados su Ataque y su Defensa.
coaching.descEN: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
coaching.efectoMovEN: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

flip-turn.descES: Tras atacar, el usuario da paso a toda prisa a otro Pokémon del equipo.
