flip-turn.descEN: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
flip-turn.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

triple-axel.descES: Patea hasta tres veces seguidas y cada vez más fuerte.
triple-axel.descEN: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
triple-axel.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply.

dual-wingbeat.descES: Ataca al adversario golpeándolo dos veces con las alas.
dual-wingbeat.descEN: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
dual-wingbeat.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

scorching-sands.descES: Ataca al objetivo arrojándole arena a temperaturas muy elevadas. Puede causar quemaduras.
scorching-sands.descEN: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
scorching-sands.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

jungle-healing.descES: Al entrar en plena armonía con la selva, el usuario cura problemas de estado y restaura PS no solo de sí mismo, sino también de los aliados presentes en el terreno.
jungle-healing.descEN: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
jungle-healing.efectoMovEN: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.

wicked-blow.descES: Golpe devastador que requiere un absoluto dominio de las artes siniestras. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
wicked-blow.descEN: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
wicked-blow.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

surging-strikes.descES: El usuario, dominador absoluto del líquido elemento, golpea hasta tres veces con movimientos fluidos. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.
surging-strikes.descEN: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.
surging-strikes.efectoMovEN: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.

thunder-cage.descES: El objetivo queda atrapado en una jaula electrificada que permanece en el terreno de cuatro a cinco turnos.
thunder-cage.descEN: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
thunder-cage.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

dragon-energy.descES: El usuario convierte su fuerza vital en una energía con la que ataca al objetivo. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, menor será la potencia del movimiento.
dragon-energy.descEN: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
dragon-energy.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

freezing-glare.descES: A través de sus ojos emite poderes psíquicos con los que ataca al objetivo, al que puede llegar a congelar.
freezing-glare.descEN: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
freezing-glare.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

fiery-wrath.descES: El usuario convierte su ira en un aura flamígera para lanzar su ataque. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
fiery-wrath.descEN: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.
fiery-wrath.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

thunderous-kick.descES: El usuario desconcierta al rival con movimientos centelleantes y le propina una patada. Baja la Defensa del objetivo.
thunderous-kick.descEN: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
thunderous-kick.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

glacial-lance.descES: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole un carámbano de hielo envuelto en una ventisca.
glacial-lance.descEN: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

astral-barrage.descES: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole una ingente cantidad de pequeños fantasmas.
astral-barrage.descEN: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

eerie-spell.descES: El usuario ataca con un poder psíquico de inmensa potencia y elimina 3 PP del último movimiento que haya usado el objetivo.
eerie-spell.descEN: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
eerie-spell.efectoMovEN: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.

dire-claw.descEN: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

psyshield-bash.descEN: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

power-shift.descEN: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

stone-axe.descEN: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

springtide-storm.descEN: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

mystical-power.descEN: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

raging-fury.descEN: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

wave-crash.descEN: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

chloroblast.descEN: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

mountain-gale.descEN: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

victory-dance.descEN: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

headlong-rush.descEN: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

barb-barrage.descEN: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

esper-wing.descEN: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

bitter-malice.descEN: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

shelter.descEN: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

triple-arrows.descEN: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

infernal-parade.descEN: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

ceaseless-edge.descEN: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

bleakwind-storm.descEN: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

wildbolt-storm.descEN: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

sandsear-storm.descEN: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

lunar-blessing.descEN: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

take-heart.descEN: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tera-blast.descEN: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

silk-trap.descEN: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

axe-kick.descEN: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

last-respects.descEN: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

lumina-crash.descEN: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

order-up.descEN: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

jet-punch.descEN: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

spicy-extract.descEN: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

spin-out.descEN: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

population-bomb.descEN: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

ice-spinner.descEN: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

glaive-rush.descEN: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

revival-blessing.descEN: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

salt-cure.descEN: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

triple-dive.descEN: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

mortal-spin.descEN: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

doodle.descEN: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

fillet-away.descEN: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

kowtow-cleave.descEN: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

flower-trick.descEN: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

torch-song.descEN: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

aqua-step.descEN: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

raging-bull.descEN: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

make-it-rain.descEN: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

psyblade.descEN: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

hydro-steam.descEN: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

ruination.descEN: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

collision-course.descEN: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

electro-drift.descEN: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

shed-tail.descEN: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

chilly-reception.descEN: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

tidy-up.descEN: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

snowscape.descEN: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

pounce.descEN: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

trailblaze.descEN: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

chilling-water.descEN: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

hyper-drill.descEN: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

twin-beam.descEN: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

rage-fist.descEN: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

armor-cannon.descEN: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

bitter-blade.descEN: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

double-shock.descEN: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

gigaton-hammer.descEN: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

comeuppance.descEN: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

aqua-cutter.descEN: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

blood-moon.descEN: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

matcha-gotcha.descEN: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

syrup-bomb.descEN: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

ivy-cudgel.descEN: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

electro-shot.descEN: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

tera-starstorm.descEN: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

fickle-beam.descEN: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

burning-bulwark.descEN: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

thunderclap.descEN: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

mighty-cleave.descEN: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

tachyon-cutter.descEN: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

hard-press.descEN: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

dragon-cheer.descEN: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

alluring-voice.descEN: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

temper-flare.descEN: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

supercell-slam.descEN: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

psychic-noise.descEN: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

upper-hand.descEN: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

malignant-chain.descEN: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

shadow-rush.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move while in hyper mode.

shadow-blast.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

shadow-bolt.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

shadow-chill.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

shadow-end.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 of its current HP in recoil.

shadow-fire.efectoMovEN: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

shadow-down.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

shadow-half.efectoMovEN: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

shadow-hold.efectoMovEN: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

shadow-mist.efectoMovEN: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.

shadow-shed.efectoMovEN: Removes the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

shadow-sky.efectoMovEN: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns. Pokémon other than Shadow Pokémon take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. This move is typeless for the purposes of Weather Ball.
